000b7842d0e0.en: Sinoi just made another short burst of noise that resembled words, now sounding more annoyed, “Ju’sta’i’ridg.” He didn’t even look at the map or Harry.
000b7842d0e0.t: Sinoi hanya mengeluarkan semburan singkat bunyi lain yang mirip kata-kata, kini terdengar lebih kesal, “Du’ak’aja’di’ke’ta.” Ia bahkan tidak memandang peta atau Harry.

00a80f9a22e7.en: Gripping his badge tightly, Harry nodded as his eyes also grew wet. “Thanks, Eiri. Thanks, Sora!” He could feel this sensation of freedom he had never felt before, but part of him still wanted to stay at Sanbi Castle for a bit longer. He looked back at the massive door as the guard strained himself hard to close it. His chest gripped with a longing already developing, but it wasn’t as strong as the excitement of jumping into the unknown.
00a80f9a22e7.t: Menggenggam erat lencananya, Harry mengangguk sementara matanya juga basah. “Terima kasih, Eiri. Terima kasih, Sora!” Ia bisa merasakan sensasi kebebasan yang belum pernah ia rasakan sebelumnya, tetapi sebagian dirinya masih ingin tinggal di Kastil Sanbi sedikit lebih lama. Ia menoleh ke pintu raksasa itu saat seorang pengawal bersusah payah menutupnya. Dadanya tercengkeram rasa rindu yang sudah mulai tumbuh, tetapi tidak sekuat kegembiraan melompat ke hal yang tidak diketahui.

0359b5f8d118.en: “My badge!” Harry cried out amidst shallow breaths. Standing sloppily up, he cleaned away the dirt from his eyes as he forced his spazzing leg forward. The stitching pain contrasted with the lightheadedness he was developing. All that slowed him down to a zombie crawl as he pushed himself to move forward, one step at time.
0359b5f8d118.t: “Lencanaku!” Harry berteriak di sela-sela napasnya yang dangkal. Berdiri dengan asal-asalan, ia menyeka tanah dari matanya sambil memaksa kakinya yang kejang maju. Rasa sakit seperti ditusuk-tusuk bertolak belakang dengan rasa pening yang mulai ia rasakan. Semua itu memperlambatnya menjadi merangkak seperti zombi saat ia memaksa dirinya bergerak maju, satu langkah demi satu langkah.

05b8254f898b.en: “Since the so-called Sanbi-eye is still here, tell me then—what is Itagiba’s father’s name?” Arukia’s pointy nose looked like it was about to stab Harry in the face like a swordfish.
05b8254f898b.t: “Karena si Sanbi-eye yang katanya itu masih di sini, coba katakan padaku—siapa nama ayah Itagiba?” Hidung Arukia yang mancung tampak seperti akan menusuk wajah Harry seperti ikan todak.

0ab499802258.en: “I’m kidding! I’m kidding!” Eiri pointed at a nearby carriage. “Neferteri told me all you need to know about your new job is in the bag and that Sinoi would give you extra details, so have fun, Harry! Sora and I will be here waiting for you!” Eiri winked. “I will make sure no one else proposes to her!”
0ab499802258.t: “Aku bercanda! Aku bercanda!” Eiri menunjuk sebuah kereta di dekatnya. “Neferteri bilang semua yang perlu kamu ketahui tentang pekerjaan barumu ada di tas dan bahwa Sinoi akan memberimu detail tambahan, jadi bersenang-senanglah, Harry! Sora dan aku akan di sini menunggumu!” Eiri mengedipkan mata. “Akan kupastikan tidak ada orang lain yang melamarnya!”

0dae9ce0159b.en: “E-co-no-mi-cal!” Arukia enunicated with the same promiscuous tone as she grabbed the rest of Harry’s sandwich, dipped it into a hearty amount of green sauce, and took a small bite, leaving a red lip mark. With her hand in her mouth, quickly chewing the bite down, she then said, “Who’s the boss of each department?”
0dae9ce0159b.t: “E-ko-no-mi!” Arukia melafalkannya dengan nada genit yang sama sambil merebut sisa sandwich Harry, mencelupkannya ke saus hijau dalam jumlah banyak, dan menggigitnya sedikit, meninggalkan bekas bibir merah. Dengan tangan di depan mulutnya, cepat-cepat mengunyah gigitan itu, ia lalu berkata, “Siapa bos masing-masing departemen?”

0dc42e216c2b.en: “FIN’” Sinoi angrily shouted. “Aft’Dea’Woz’I’stop—” Sinoi lashed the egua again, making it canter harder.
0dc42e216c2b.t: “YA’UDA’” Sinoi berteriak marah. “Ha’is’Dea’Woz’ku’ber’hen’i—” Sinoi melecut egua lagi, membuatnya berlari lebih kencang.

0fa1c456a0f3.en: Eiri helped Harry put the bag over his shoulder, then took a step back to look at the complete uniform—her appearance was like that of a mother about to let her kid go to college but treating them as if they were still in kindergarten. “Everything you need is in the bag. Make sure not to lose it, especially the purse! The badge too! Otherwise, you can’t withdraw more balls at the embassy!” Her eyes grew kindly trembling, coincidentally getting wetter. “I’m happy for you, Harry.”
0fa1c456a0f3.t: Eiri membantu Harry menyandang tas itu di bahunya, lalu mundur selangkah untuk melihat seragam lengkapnya—penampilannya seperti seorang ibu yang akan melepas anaknya kuliah tetapi memperlakukannya seolah masih di TK. “Semua yang kamu butuhkan ada di tas. Pastikan tidak hilang, terutama dompetnya! Lencananya juga! Kalau tidak, kamu tidak bisa menarik bola lagi di kedutaan!” Matanya bergetar dengan lembut, kebetulan semakin basah. “Aku senang untukmu, Harry.”

0fae778c67b6.en: In the middle of the atrium, surrounded by stairs and a sizeable fost lamp above, Sora stood by with her hands up front, already red in the face—maybe she had rosacea after all or was in a constant state of embarrassment. She bowed apologetically, speaking at such a fast, worried pace that she wasn’t a rap god anymore but the rap universe itself. “I’m sorry, Harry, but I don’t want to marry too young. I have the family business to care for—and—I’m waiting for my prince to arrive!” She quickly paced towards the door leading out of Sanbi Castle, then opened it wide for Eiri and Harry.
0fae778c67b6.t: Di tengah atrium, dikelilingi tangga dan lampu fost yang cukup besar di atasnya, Sora berdiri dengan tangan di depan, wajahnya sudah merah—mungkin ia memang menderita rosacea atau terus-menerus dalam keadaan malu. Ia membungkuk meminta maaf, berbicara dengan kecepatan yang begitu cepat dan cemas sampai ia bukan lagi dewa rap melainkan alam semesta rap itu sendiri. “Maafkan saya, Harry, tapi saya tidak mau menikah terlalu muda. Saya harus mengurus usaha keluarga—dan—saya sedang menunggu pangeran saya datang!” Ia cepat-cepat berjalan ke pintu yang mengarah keluar dari Kastil Sanbi, lalu membukanya lebar-lebar untuk Eiri dan Harry.

166b16603e79.en: Meanwhile, Harry’s eyes looked to be moistening up on their own. I actually don’t really know shit! Was I supposed to learn stuff? But how? Nobody even told me about it! Not even Eiri! Harry dropped his head as he held the mostly empty plate in his lap. Fingering the leftover sauces, he nibbled on them to appease the culpable feelings rattling in his chest. The white sauce tasted like homemade butter mayonnaise, while the greenish one was akin to black pepper and cumin mixed with a tangy chlorophyll accent. Good on their own, but when he mixed them with the meaty sandwich, they elevated the taste from something bought at a supermarket to one handmade by a world-renowned chef—or perhaps Harry’s hunger could be pushing the flavors to new heights.
166b16603e79.t: Sementara itu, mata Harry tampak berkaca-kaca dengan sendirinya. Aku sebenarnya tidak tahu apa-apa! Apa aku seharusnya mempelajari sesuatu? Tapi bagaimana? Bahkan tidak ada yang memberitahuku! Eiri juga tidak! Harry menundukkan kepalanya sambil memegang piring yang hampir kosong di pangkuannya. Mencolek sisa-sisa saus, ia menjilatinya untuk meredakan perasaan bersalah yang bergemuruh di dadanya. Saus putih itu rasanya seperti mayones mentega buatan rumah, sementara yang kehijauan mirip lada hitam dan jintan bercampur aksen klorofil yang segar. Enak sendiri-sendiri, tetapi saat ia mencampurnya dengan sandwich daging, keduanya mengangkat rasanya dari sesuatu yang dibeli di supermarket menjadi buatan tangan koki terkenal dunia—atau mungkin rasa lapar Harry yang mendorong rasanya ke tingkat yang lebih tinggi.

16cd6aac584a.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 4: Harry hides behind a tree in a dark forest, watching a cart on the road.
16cd6aac584a.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 4: Harry bersembunyi di balik pohon di hutan yang gelap, mengawasi sebuah kereta di jalan.

1725aca8f78c.en: Harry squealed like a dying pig, sobbing with pure anguish from his heart. The sob became gurgly. The gurgly noises grew weaker as Harry felt a wave of calmness surface from deep within—telling him to just let it go. Wanna—go—home. Harry let go of everything.
1725aca8f78c.t: Harry memekik seperti babi sekarat, terisak dengan penderitaan murni dari hatinya. Isakannya menjadi berdeguk. Bunyi berdeguk itu semakin lemah saat Harry merasakan gelombang ketenangan muncul dari dalam—menyuruhnya melepaskan saja. Mau—pulang—ke rumah. Harry melepaskan segalanya.

189a357433fa.en: Harry’s eyes, initially entranced by the beauty of her fierier-than-the-fireplace cyan eyes, felt a gravity tug towards the valley of fun that her breasts looked like.
189a357433fa.t: Mata Harry, yang awalnya terpesona oleh keindahan mata sian Arukia yang lebih membara daripada perapian, merasakan tarikan gravitasi ke arah lembah kesenangan yang tampak seperti payudaranya.

1a5e441169c6.en: Harry’s eyes widened as that challenge seemed too good to be true. Resting his plate on his lap, he narrowed his eyes towards the same white ceiling, but now his eyes were no longer a blurry mess. Eiri just mentioned that! It was—oh yes! He began blurting the answers out, “Monarchy! And—and—soul energy!” Harry kept on searching, but his memories came up short.
1a5e441169c6.t: Mata Harry membelalak karena tantangan itu tampak terlalu bagus untuk jadi kenyataan. Meletakkan piringnya di pangkuannya, ia menyipitkan mata ke langit-langit putih yang sama, tetapi kini matanya tidak lagi buram berantakan. Eiri baru saja menyebutkannya! Itu—oh iya! Ia mulai menyemburkan jawabannya, “Monarki! Dan—dan—energi jiwa!” Harry terus mencari, tetapi ingatannya tidak cukup.

204f912f9004.en: Another sharp metallic bang went off, making another arrow strike him in his lower back, deep into his stomach. The same vicious girly laugh ensued, now closer than before.
204f912f9004.t: Bunyi dentang logam yang tajam lainnya terdengar, membuat anak panah lain menghantamnya di punggung bawah, menembus dalam ke perutnya. Tawa feminin keji yang sama menyusul, kini lebih dekat dari sebelumnya.

20cd4725f7c8.en: Sinoi lazily pulled the reins towards the right, keeping the egua encircling the round castle wall rather than turning left in a T-intersection. Somehow that was the only second signal Sinoi inputted so far. The egua apparently had a decent autopilot to keep encircling the round wall, avoiding people, things, and even the sturdy-looking brick fost lamp that littered the middle of the streets, equally spaced out from one another.
20cd4725f7c8.t: Sinoi dengan malas menarik tali kekang ke kanan, menjaga egua tetap mengitari tembok kastil yang bundar alih-alih belok kiri di persimpangan T. Entah bagaimana itu baru isyarat kedua yang diberikan Sinoi sejauh ini. Egua itu tampaknya punya autopilot yang lumayan untuk terus mengitari tembok bundar, menghindari orang, benda, dan bahkan tiang lampu fost stone dari bata yang tampak kokoh yang tersebar di tengah jalan, berjarak sama satu sama lain.

236257246e3a.en: Sinoi verged right on another split off on the road, towards a new road that seemed less frequently used. The forest was overgrowing, trying to reclaim the narrow road. Only far echoes of the lively band and villagers could be heard, with the white gloom of the village also growing distant in the sky.
236257246e3a.t: Sinoi berbelok ke kanan di percabangan lain di jalan itu, menuju jalan baru yang tampaknya lebih jarang dilalui. Hutan tumbuh liar, berusaha merebut kembali jalan yang sempit itu. Hanya gema jauh dari band yang meriah dan para penduduk desa yang bisa terdengar, dengan cahaya putih redup desa itu juga semakin jauh di langit.

237bd2b93d1b.en: OH! Fishing Tree! His eyes spotted the village northeast of Sanbi’s capital, by a river flowing into the ocean. Seeing how to get back to the capital, Harry’s eyes followed the dots as they traveled the river upstream to Sanbi East village, which had a connection back to inland travel. From that village back to Sanbi kingdom, it looked like there were multiple stops along the way, with several more throughout the capital. The most populated part, the kingdom’s central region, where the capital lay, looked like a downward triangle. Smack in the middle of that downward triangle was Sanbi Castle, written in large font. Twenty-two pearls? Does that mean it’s far away? Harry’s sense of distance was purely a gut feeling. “Haaa—Sinoi?”
237bd2b93d1b.t: OH! Fishing Tree! Matanya menemukan desa di timur laut ibu kota Sanbi, di dekat sungai yang mengalir ke lautan. Melihat cara kembali ke ibu kota, mata Harry mengikuti titik-titik itu saat menyusuri sungai ke hulu menuju desa Sanbi East, yang punya sambungan kembali ke perjalanan darat. Dari desa itu kembali ke kerajaan Sanbi, tampaknya ada banyak pemberhentian di sepanjang jalan, dengan beberapa lagi di seluruh ibu kota. Bagian yang paling padat penduduknya, wilayah tengah kerajaan, tempat ibu kota berada, tampak seperti segitiga terbalik. Tepat di tengah segitiga terbalik itu tertulis Sanbi Castle dengan huruf besar. Dua puluh dua pearl? Apa itu berarti jauh? Perasaan Harry tentang jarak murni berdasarkan firasat. “Haaa—Sinoi?”

23fa6eddd623.en: With a cutesy motion, Sora’s small hands handed a credit card–sized object towards Harry with his name on it.
23fa6eddd623.t: Dengan gerakan yang imut, tangan mungil Sora menyerahkan sebuah benda seukuran kartu kredit dengan namanya kepada Harry.

263d4947549c.en: “ARGGH!” Harry screamed in pain. The concoction now began to quickly spread and numb his gut as well. The concoction, at this point, had reached his lungs, diaphragm, and heart, forcing them to calm down, suffocating Harry from within as his wide-open mouth couldn’t draw as much oxygen as he desperately needed. His right arm was now wholly numb even though the pain was lingering there, but it now felt like it was happening outside his own body—like the pseudo pain you feel when you see someone else get badly hurt. A loud thought passed through his brain as if his instincts took the shape of another voice in his head: Hide! He slumped himself out of the bush, then wobbled his way forward as he began to lose the sensation of where his body ended and nature began. Striking a tree with his shoulder, he groaned, then slumped towards the ground behind it, resting on his side. With the last remnants of his will to control his numbing body, he covered his mouth with his mostly numb, somewhat responsive left hand to attempt to silence his anguished breath.
263d4947549c.t: “ARGGH!” Harry berteriak kesakitan. Ramuan itu kini mulai cepat menyebar dan membuat perutnya mati rasa juga. Ramuan itu, pada titik ini, telah mencapai paru-paru, diafragma, dan jantungnya, memaksa mereka tenang, mencekik Harry dari dalam karena mulutnya yang terbuka lebar tidak bisa menarik oksigen sebanyak yang sangat ia butuhkan. Lengan kanannya kini sepenuhnya mati rasa walaupun rasa sakitnya masih membekas di sana, tetapi kini rasanya seperti terjadi di luar tubuhnya sendiri—seperti rasa sakit semu yang kamu rasakan saat melihat orang lain terluka parah. Pikiran yang keras melintas di otaknya seolah nalurinya mengambil bentuk suara lain di kepalanya: Sembunyi! Ia menyeret dirinya keluar dari semak-semak, lalu terhuyung-huyung maju saat ia mulai kehilangan sensasi di mana tubuhnya berakhir dan alam dimulai. Menabrakkan bahunya ke sebuah pohon, ia mengerang, lalu merosot ke tanah di belakangnya, berbaring miring. Dengan sisa-sisa terakhir tekadnya untuk mengendalikan tubuhnya yang semakin mati rasa, ia menutup mulutnya dengan tangan kirinya yang sebagian besar mati rasa namun masih agak merespons untuk mencoba meredam napasnya yang tersiksa.

26867c01b10c.en: “I’SID’STA’I’RIDGE! I’NOT’PAYIN’A’SIN’BAL!” Sinoi blurted out loudly, spitting another blob from the corner of his mouth, and then lashed his reins, increasing the speed of the carriage. “I’ha’a’contrac’t’fill’too—” Sinoi blurted out loudly, with a rather saddening tone. The white sky gloom and the music were growing closer; the village outskirts were mere tens of seconds away.
26867c01b10c.t: “KU’BI’ANG’DU’UK’AJA’DI’KE’TA! KU’GAK’MAU’BA’AR’SE’BI’JI’BO’A!” Sinoi menyembur keras, meludahkan gumpalan lain dari sudut mulutnya, lalu melecutkan tali kekangnya, menambah kecepatan kereta. “Ku’pu’ya’kon’rak’ha’us’di’pe’nu’hi’ju’a—” Sinoi menyembur keras, dengan nada yang agak sedih. Cahaya putih di langit dan musiknya semakin dekat; pinggiran desa tinggal puluhan detik lagi.

29dbd6132814.en: Strangers passed by, from Cruros to humans, Darfaries, to even Sorefaries. They all looked unique in their ways, with some being as much as eye candy like Sora, to others giving you a bad feeling from just crossing your eyes with them. Animals he had never seen or heard about before were either alive with people, being sliced apart, hanging from hooks, or being fried in parked wagons that were selling street food, competing with the restaurants for people’s hunger. The smells of the streets tickled his nose with a head-spinning amount of new things, from street food he had never tasted before to perfume. Amidst all those smells, something quite familiar rose above everything else—the smell of horse shit. Harry looked towards the ground, expecting to see horse shit staining everywhere, but found nothing. Where is that coming from? Another wave of the same rotten gaseous leafy smell came from a rustic-looking but not as worn-out carriage passing by. A heavy-looking bag underneath the bunghole of the passing egua looked like it was about to rip apart and splat shit everywhere.
29dbd6132814.t: Orang-orang asing lewat, dari Cruros sampai manusia, Darfaries, bahkan Sorefaries. Mereka semua tampak unik dengan cara mereka masing-masing, dengan sebagian sama enaknya dipandang seperti Sora, sampai yang lain memberimu perasaan buruk hanya dengan bertemu pandang dengan mereka. Hewan-hewan yang belum pernah ia lihat atau dengar sebelumnya ada yang hidup bersama orang-orang, ada yang sedang diiris-iris, digantung di kait, atau digoreng di kereta-kereta yang diparkir yang menjual jajanan kaki lima, bersaing dengan restoran-restoran untuk rasa lapar orang-orang. Bau jalanan menggelitik hidungnya dengan jumlah hal baru yang memusingkan, dari jajanan kaki lima yang belum pernah ia cicipi sampai parfum. Di tengah semua bau itu, sesuatu yang cukup familier muncul melampaui semuanya—bau tahi kuda. Harry memandang ke tanah, berharap melihat tahi kuda menodai di mana-mana, tetapi tidak menemukan apa-apa. Dari mana itu? Gelombang lain bau dedaunan busuk bergas yang sama datang dari sebuah kereta yang tampak sederhana tetapi tidak terlalu usang yang lewat. Sebuah kantong yang tampak berat di bawah lubang pantat egua yang lewat itu tampak seperti akan robek dan memercikkan tahi ke mana-mana.

2a31aab073ff.en: Harry couldn’t help himself but take another glance at her utterly waifu qualities. In the depths of his brain, the word simp flashed into existence.
2a31aab073ff.t: Harry tidak bisa menahan diri untuk melirik sekali lagi kualitas waifu-nya yang luar biasa. Di kedalaman otaknya, kata simp muncul begitu saja.

2b6d37e7db09.en: Just stay in ridge? Harry sat back, scratching his neck beard as he looked at the map. Ridge? I don’t see any stop by that name.
2b6d37e7db09.t: Duduk saja di Keta? Harry bersandar kembali, menggaruk janggut lehernya sambil memandang peta. Keta? Aku tidak melihat pemberhentian dengan nama itu.

2b86caa22067.en: With six shared wagon stops left behind him, Harry saw the sun getting ready to set. The feeling of discovery was still there, but not as strong as before. Harry’s lips longed for water; his stomach longed for sustenance; his bladder longed for relief; and his coccyx longed for a bed. Passing by a shared front yard of four houses, Harry heard a loud clash of wooden swords; three kids cheered on while another two battled. One of them stood his ground while the other came rushing towards him with an upward attack—Harry could almost see him and Maiara as kids doing the same thing too. Maiara’s uvula dangling as she grunted loudly, swinging her hammer at him, was still far too vivid in his memory. Pain and fear still lingered in his brain, but quirky happiness rose through them. Did I really grow up here like Eiri said?
2b86caa22067.t: Dengan enam pemberhentian kereta tumpangan tertinggal di belakangnya, Harry melihat matahari bersiap terbenam. Perasaan penemuan masih ada, tetapi tidak sekuat sebelumnya. Bibir Harry mendambakan air; perutnya mendambakan makanan; kandung kemihnya mendambakan kelegaan; dan tulang ekornya mendambakan ranjang. Melewati halaman depan bersama empat rumah, Harry mendengar benturan keras pedang-pedang kayu; tiga anak bersorak sementara dua lainnya bertarung. Salah satunya bertahan di tempat sementara yang lain berlari menerjangnya dengan serangan ke atas—Harry hampir bisa melihat dirinya dan Maiara sebagai anak-anak melakukan hal yang sama. Anak lidah Maiara yang bergoyang saat ia mendengus keras, mengayunkan palunya ke arahnya, masih terlalu jelas dalam ingatannya. Rasa sakit dan takut masih membekas di otaknya, tetapi kebahagiaan yang aneh muncul menembusnya. Apa aku benar-benar tumbuh besar di sini seperti kata Eiri?

2c90de3b7b96.en: “But—but—what about—” The short double high-pitched call kept rubbing Harry’s conscience the wrong way.
2c90de3b7b96.t: “Tapi—tapi—bagaimana dengan—” Panggilan pendek bernada tinggi dua kali itu terus mengusik nurani Harry.

2d6ca5e7c7a9.en: Itanema opened a drawer, grabbed long metal tongs, and started flipping over the meat cooking in the fireplace. The fire roared with each drip of meat juices as she turned them over, letting a meaty, smokey smell escape from the chimney and tantalize everyone in the room.
2d6ca5e7c7a9.t: Itanema membuka laci, mengambil penjepit logam panjang, dan mulai membalik daging yang sedang dimasak di perapian. Api menderu setiap kali cairan daging menetes saat ia membaliknya, membiarkan bau daging berasap keluar dari cerobong dan menggoda semua orang di ruangan itu.

2ddd1664c074.en: What did he say? Harry scooched forward on his seat and brought his head parallel to Sinoi’s. “I-I am sorry—Sinoi. Can you say it again?”
2ddd1664c074.t: Dia bilang apa? Harry bergeser maju di kursinya dan menyejajarkan kepalanya dengan kepala Sinoi. “M-maaf—Sinoi. Bisa diulangi?”

2e26544ab740.en: The carriage continued, passing the shared wagon stop without signs of slowing down, and instead heading towards the dark forests at the end of the village. The music was loud, the booze flowed, the bonfire was hot, and sweaty big tits bounced around—it looked like nobody noticed or cared that a carriage was passing through. “Ahea’!” Sinoi blurted out, lashing the reins to force the egua straight into the darkness.
2e26544ab740.t: Kereta itu terus melaju, melewati pemberhentian kereta tumpangan tanpa tanda-tanda melambat, malah menuju hutan gelap di ujung desa. Musiknya keras, minuman keras mengalir, api unggunnya panas, dan payudara besar yang berkeringat berguncang ke sana kemari—tampaknya tidak ada yang memperhatikan atau peduli bahwa sebuah kereta sedang lewat. “Ma’u!” Sinoi menyembur, melecutkan tali kekang untuk memaksa egua lurus ke dalam kegelapan.

2ebbf76a3eee.en: Arukia bamboozled him at the last second, bringing the sandwich to her mouth instead. She then whipped her hand on Harry’s uniform and stood up to grab a glass of water by partially opening a handle attached to a large pipe on top of the sink. The usual angry gush of water didn’t seem as loud.
2ebbf76a3eee.t: Arukia mengecohnya di detik terakhir, malah memasukkan sandwich itu ke mulutnya sendiri. Ia lalu menyeka tangannya di seragam Harry dan berdiri untuk mengambil segelas air dengan membuka sebagian tuas yang terpasang di pipa besar di atas wastafel. Semburan air marah yang biasa tidak terdengar sekeras biasanya.

2ff97a3d25b0.en: The light from the fost lamp shooed away the encroaching darkness; Harry’s shoulder slumped slightly as his old carriage now felt like a haven against the forest’s darkness. Is that a shared wagon? Oh! It is! The passing-by wagon had Pamto’s Shared Wagon written on the side. Exchanging eyes with the passengers, his eyes were drawn particularly to a girl sleeping—or rather, passed out in the back by herself. Her black undershirt and leggings and white and pink unique clothing looked pretty worn, and they were all soaked in blood and mud stains. Her backpack and bow were resting by her feet and weren’t in good condition either. Harry felt a familiar sense out of her, but he couldn’t pinpoint where or when. He raised his hand towards her, but when he tried to raise his voice to her, the wagon had already passed by.
2ff97a3d25b0.t: Cahaya dari lampu fost mengusir kegelapan yang merayap; bahu Harry sedikit merosot karena kereta tuanya kini terasa seperti tempat berlindung dari kegelapan hutan. Apa itu kereta tumpangan? Oh! Benar! Kereta yang lewat itu bertuliskan Pamto’s Shared Wagon di sampingnya. Bertukar pandang dengan para penumpang, matanya terutama tertarik pada seorang gadis yang sedang tidur—atau lebih tepatnya, tak sadarkan diri di belakang sendirian. Kaus dalam dan legging hitamnya serta pakaian putih dan merah muda yang unik tampak cukup usang, dan semuanya basah oleh noda darah dan lumpur. Ransel dan busurnya tergeletak di dekat kakinya dan kondisinya juga tidak bagus. Harry merasakan sesuatu yang familier darinya, tetapi ia tidak bisa memastikan di mana atau kapan. Ia mengangkat tangannya ke arah gadis itu, tetapi saat ia mencoba memanggilnya, kereta itu sudah lewat.

327933f296ef.en: What was that? Only the forest, its animals, and the egua neighs made a sound. The same odd short double high-pitched call echoed in the woods again, making the hair on Harry’s back rise. The thought of stepping out of the carriage made his feet hesitate, but his bladder was on its limits. The tree’s leaves seemed to mock him from the shadows cast by the fost lamp in the carriage. “But—leave my bag here?”
327933f296ef.t: Apa itu tadi? Hanya hutan, hewan-hewannya, dan ringkikan egua yang bersuara. Panggilan pendek bernada tinggi dua kali yang aneh itu menggema lagi di hutan, membuat bulu di punggung Harry berdiri. Pikiran untuk turun dari kereta membuat kakinya ragu, tetapi kandung kemihnya sudah di batasnya. Daun-daun pohon tampak mengejeknya dari bayangan yang dilemparkan lampu fost di kereta. “Tapi—tasku ditinggal di sini?”

33624db12067.en: “BY THE ORDER OF EIRI SANBI ROYAL, OPEN THE DOOR!” Eiri spoke loudly at the gate, and sure enough, the familiar sounds of screaming hinges began as large, heavy doors creaked open towards them.
33624db12067.t: “ATAS PERINTAH EIRI SANBI ROYAL, BUKA PINTUNYA!” Eiri berbicara keras di gerbang, dan benar saja, bunyi engsel menjerit yang familier dimulai saat pintu-pintu besar yang berat berderit terbuka ke arah mereka.

33d9b3d502df.en: Sinoi let out a long, tired, loud exhale—like someone would if their boss suddenly asked to stay overtime on a Friday night. “Che’ya’map” He spoke louder but just as mumbled as usual.
33d9b3d502df.t: Sinoi mengembuskan napas panjang, lelah, dan keras—seperti yang dilakukan seseorang kalau bosnya tiba-tiba memintanya lembur di Jumat malam. “Li’at’pe’ta’mu” Ia berbicara lebih keras tetapi sama tidak jelasnya seperti biasa.

3456eb7c70be.en: Harry looked behind the kids playing some sort of duel. Not far from them, three ladies talked amongst themselves under a bright fost lamp, while a guy not far from them brought another lamp to life—similar to what Sora showed to Harry. By him, two other guys seemed very busy drinking and chatting away, roasting a nice hunk of meat. One of them raised his mug towards Harry, and he waved back. With the smell of sizzling skin spreading through the air far and wide, Harry imagined himself sitting alongside them, wetting his lips on beer and helping them utterly destroy that barbeque with his salivating teeth.
3456eb7c70be.t: Harry memandang ke balik anak-anak yang sedang memainkan semacam duel itu. Tak jauh dari mereka, tiga wanita mengobrol di bawah lampu fost yang terang, sementara seorang pria tak jauh dari mereka menyalakan lampu lain—mirip dengan yang ditunjukkan Sora kepada Harry. Di dekatnya, dua pria lain tampak sangat sibuk minum dan mengobrol, memanggang sepotong daging yang enak. Salah satu dari mereka mengangkat gelasnya ke arah Harry, dan ia balas melambai. Dengan bau kulit yang mendesis menyebar luas di udara, Harry membayangkan dirinya duduk bersama mereka, membasahi bibirnya dengan bir dan membantu mereka menghabisi barbeque itu dengan giginya yang mengeluarkan air liur.

3457f83a2b23.en: “Not even a guess?” Arukia retracted away from Harry with a snappy tone. Looking towards Itanema with a smug chin up, she asked tightly, “Do you even know?”
3457f83a2b23.t: “Bahkan tidak menebak?” Arukia menarik diri dari Harry dengan nada ketus. Memandang ke arah Itanema dengan dagu terangkat penuh kesombongan, ia bertanya dengan tegang, “Kau sendiri tahu tidak?”

372bf2ec02da.en: “Are you riding all the way to Fishing Tree? Can we stop at The Dead Wozen? I—isn’t the forest dangerous?” Harry scooched forward to listen to Sinoi’s babblings.
372bf2ec02da.t: “Apa kau akan naik sampai ke Fishing Tree? Bisa kita berhenti di The Dead Wozen? Ap—apa hutan tidak berbahaya?” Harry bergeser maju untuk mendengarkan ocehan Sinoi.

38be0feda423.en: Gulping, Harry looked away, his cheeks reddening. What do I do now? I have no idea.
38be0feda423.t: Menelan ludah, Harry membuang muka, pipinya memerah. Apa yang harus kulakukan sekarang? Aku tidak tahu sama sekali.

3abc2b99c08b.en: “I’wil’rop’y’off’fath’awa’—jus’lax’” Another mumble of words came out of Sinoi’s mouth, barely breaking above the rustling noises of this vibrant kingdom.
3abc2b99c08b.t: “Ku’tur’n’kau’jau’an—san’ai’aj’” Gumaman kata-kata lain keluar dari mulut Sinoi, nyaris tidak melampaui riuh kebisingan kerajaan yang hidup ini.

3bc6b3630d04.en: “I’shor’bit!’” Sinoi curtly replied as he guided the egua left on a split on the road, leaving the echoes of the live band behind.
3bc6b3630d04.t: “Ben’ar’ag’!’” jawab Sinoi singkat sambil mengarahkan egua ke kiri di sebuah percabangan jalan, meninggalkan gema band itu di belakang.

3eb683c32c59.en: Arukia looked through a window hole in the swinging door, then a sassiness rushed through her voice towards Harry, “Why are we wasting money on you? I can’t believe why the monarchy department agreed with Maiara’s stupid request!” She looked at Itanema, apparently waiting for her to pitch in.
3eb683c32c59.t: Arukia mengintip melalui lubang jendela di pintu ayun, lalu kelancangan mengalir dalam suaranya ke arah Harry, “Kenapa kita membuang uang untukmu? Aku tidak percaya departemen monarki menyetujui permintaan bodoh Maiara!” Ia memandang Itanema, tampaknya menunggunya ikut bicara.

4000506d113e.en: “Ya’lots’mud. G’pee!” Sinoi pointed backward. “G’G’it!” Sinoi made a higher-pitched squeal. “G’pee’in’th’woods!” He moved his hand outwards with an energy never seen before—at least for Sinoi. “W’can’t’b’stop’fo’too’lon’.” He said more in this short span of time than the entire afternoon.
4000506d113e.t: “Ba’yak’lum’pur. Sa’a’ken’cing!” Sinoi menunjuk ke belakang. “Sa’a!” Sinoi mengeluarkan pekikan bernada lebih tinggi. “Ken’cing’di’u’tan!” Ia menggerakkan tangannya ke luar dengan energi yang belum pernah terlihat sebelumnya—setidaknya untuk Sinoi. “Ki’a’gak’bi’sa’ber’hen’i’ke’la’ma’an.” Ia berbicara lebih banyak dalam waktu sesingkat ini daripada sepanjang sore.

42a48cf5464a.en: Harry kept looking around, noticing so many new things, but one thing in particular called to his attention. It was a group of Cruros seated at a table outside a bar, writing stuff in their journals and showing it to one another. The map! Harry pulled out a pamphlet from the bag. Its thick rough paper felt almost like sandpaper, with whatever was written or drawn on it leaving textured grooves—like holding a used carbon copy paper. Carefully unfolding, Harry saw Sanbi Kingdom Shared Wagon Routes written up top, with black inkings of what appeared to be a bunch of interconnecting dots in the roads and rivers with names, prices, and schedules. The whole thing felt familiar—yeah, this is the same Sanbi Kingdom map I saw before! But bigger? Wait—is this a bus route map of the kingdom? Wait! What’s a bus? Harry felt something come to mind. It was large, and it could fit a lot of people. Pretty boxy in shape, rectangular too—rubber wheels! Yeah— Harry looked at all the passing-by carriages and noticed some of them had something blackish akin to rubber, but it was just a thick strip at the end of wood or metal wheels. Did they look like that? I thought it was smaller and the whole thing was covered in rubber—
42a48cf5464a.t: Harry terus memandang sekeliling, memperhatikan begitu banyak hal baru, tetapi ada satu hal khusus yang menarik perhatiannya. Sekelompok Cruros duduk di meja di luar sebuah bar, menulis sesuatu di jurnal mereka dan saling menunjukkannya. Petanya! Harry mengeluarkan pamflet dari tas. Kertasnya yang tebal dan kasar terasa hampir seperti amplas, dengan apa pun yang tertulis atau tergambar di atasnya meninggalkan alur bertekstur—seperti memegang kertas karbon bekas. Dengan hati-hati membukanya, Harry melihat Sanbi Kingdom Shared Wagon Routes tertulis di bagian atas, dengan goresan tinta hitam dari sesuatu yang tampak seperti sekumpulan titik yang saling terhubung di jalan-jalan dan sungai-sungai lengkap dengan nama, harga, dan jadwal. Semuanya terasa familier—iya, ini peta Kerajaan Sanbi yang sama yang pernah kulihat sebelumnya! Tapi lebih besar? Tunggu—apa ini peta rute bus kerajaan? Tunggu! Bus itu apa? Harry merasakan sesuatu terlintas di benaknya. Benda itu besar, dan bisa memuat banyak orang. Bentuknya cukup kotak, persegi panjang juga—roda karet! Iya— Harry memandang semua kereta yang lewat dan memperhatikan sebagian punya sesuatu yang kehitaman mirip karet, tetapi hanya berupa lajur tebal di ujung roda kayu atau logam. Apa bentuknya seperti itu? Kukira lebih kecil dan seluruhnya dibalut karet—

43b6e0ea337a.en: “Ya—ya—ya—thirty-seven will erase it anyways!” A girly voice stated in a dismissive tone as a sharp metallic bang went off right in front of Harry, piercing itself deep in his trachea.
43b6e0ea337a.t: “Iya—iya—iya—tiga puluh tujuh toh akan menghapusnya!” Suara feminin berkata dengan nada meremehkan saat bunyi dentang logam yang tajam terdengar tepat di depan Harry, menembus dalam ke batang tenggorokannya.

486fc25fbd57.en: While he walked to where she pointed, butterflies flew in Harry’s growling stomach as he saw a familiar face averting her timid eyes away from him.
486fc25fbd57.t: Saat ia berjalan ke tempat yang ditunjuk Eiri, kupu-kupu beterbangan di perut Harry yang keroncongan saat ia melihat wajah familier yang mengalihkan matanya yang malu-malu darinya.

49f639e406d6.en: “Next one—your final chance.” Arukia lowered her voice, and now a promiscuous tone took over as she bit her lips. It seemed like she was ready to crank up the heat. “I’ll even let you squeeze it if you get this right—what are the three departments of Sanbi kingdom?”
49f639e406d6.t: “Yang berikutnya—kesempatan terakhirmu.” Arukia merendahkan suaranya, dan kini nada genit mengambil alih saat ia menggigit bibirnya. Tampaknya ia siap menaikkan suhu. “Aku bahkan akan membiarkanmu meremasnya kalau kau benar—apa tiga departemen kerajaan Sanbi?”

4a20a113ee6d.en: “Ah’wi’do!” Sinoi replied, but his words did not reach Eiri—heck, they barely reached Harry’s ears. With a lazy pull of the egua reins, the wagon creaked as the egua began trotting with the same laziness as its owner.
4a20a113ee6d.t: “Be’es!” jawab Sinoi, tetapi kata-katanya tidak sampai ke Eiri—astaga, nyaris tidak sampai ke telinga Harry. Dengan tarikan malas pada tali kekang egua, kereta itu berderit saat egua mulai berderap dengan kemalasan yang sama seperti pemiliknya.

4a610794ee65.en: Excitement and anxiety are born from the same root: wanting to see the future, and for Harry, that future was right now. The familiar feeling of drinking a gallon of coffee was there, but somehow he didn’t seem to hate this feeling in his chest this time entirely—if that was even the same feeling he had felt before. Perhaps it didn’t feel bad this time as he was doing something about it, as in looking around and absorbing as many details as possible of this new place he now had to call home, or that was his home, to begin with, and he just couldn’t remember.
4a610794ee65.t: Kegembiraan dan kecemasan lahir dari akar yang sama: ingin melihat masa depan, dan bagi Harry, masa depan itu adalah saat ini. Perasaan familier seperti meminum segalon kopi ada di sana, tetapi entah bagaimana kali ini ia tampaknya tidak sepenuhnya membenci perasaan di dadanya ini—kalau itu memang perasaan yang sama dengan yang pernah ia rasakan sebelumnya. Mungkin kali ini rasanya tidak buruk karena ia melakukan sesuatu tentang hal itu, yaitu melihat sekeliling dan menyerap sebanyak mungkin detail dari tempat baru yang kini harus ia sebut rumah, atau yang memang rumahnya sejak awal dan ia hanya tidak bisa mengingatnya.

50747893ff7e.en: Jumping at Eiri’s voice, Harry turned around. “Sorry! I—ehh—was just looking at the meat!” he said, smiling like a child caught with his hand in the cookie jar.
50747893ff7e.t: Terlonjak mendengar suara Eiri, Harry berbalik. “Maaf! Aku—ehh—cuma melihat dagingnya!” katanya, tersenyum seperti anak kecil yang ketahuan tangannya di toples kue.

5106ab147d33.en: Harry waved goodbye to Sora and Eiri, seeing them grow smaller with each constant lazy trot against the rocky road that shook the carriage. The massive Sanbi Castle gates grew smaller and soon vanished from Harry’s sight. The only sight left of familiarity was the Sanbi castle’s round wall as the egua kept trotting on the road around it.
5106ab147d33.t: Harry melambai pamit kepada Sora dan Eiri, melihat mereka semakin kecil di setiap derap malas yang konstan di jalan berbatu yang mengguncang kereta. Gerbang Kastil Sanbi yang raksasa semakin kecil dan segera lenyap dari pandangan Harry. Satu-satunya pemandangan familier yang tersisa adalah tembok bundar kastil Sanbi saat egua terus berderap di jalan yang mengitarinya.

583c5bdc6baf.en: Still chewing the monstrous bite behind her hand, Arukia shook her head. She snapped her fingers towards Itanema, but she didn’t seem to get a reply. With a nice gulp and a pinched expression, Arukia spoke up to the other maid, “Itanema?”
583c5bdc6baf.t: Masih mengunyah gigitan raksasa di balik tangannya, Arukia menggeleng. Ia menjentikkan jarinya ke arah Itanema, tetapi tampaknya tidak mendapat jawaban. Dengan tegukan yang enak dan raut terjepit, Arukia berbicara kepada pelayan yang lain, “Itanema?”

5b41beceaba5.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 1: a brown-haired woman offers Harry a bite of food in a kitchen with hanging pots.
5b41beceaba5.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 1: seorang wanita berambut cokelat menyodorkan sesuap makanan kepada Harry di dapur dengan panci-panci yang tergantung.

5c919fe452ad.en: The carriage now began leaving the large castle walls behind. Marching to the East.
5c919fe452ad.t: Kereta itu kini mulai meninggalkan tembok kastil yang besar di belakang. Bergerak ke Timur.

5d3df23978ab.en: “The king and queen of Sanbi, Itagiba Sanbi Royal and Neferteri Sanbi Royal.” Itanema once again replied from the tip of her tongue as she kept brooming—one could even think the spontaneous game show was rigged.
5d3df23978ab.t: “Raja dan ratu Sanbi, Itagiba Sanbi Royal dan Neferteri Sanbi Royal.” Itanema sekali lagi menjawab di luar kepala sambil terus menyapu—orang bahkan bisa mengira kuis dadakan itu sudah diatur.

607c6a01ed91.en: Itanema sucked on her blistered fingers of one hand for a hot second, taking them out when they healed completely. She then devoted herself back to the fireplace, grabbing a boiling sausage from the flames and taking a bite. Boiling steam came out of her mouth like she was puffing out a cigar, but she seemed pretty intent on eating it. Not even a single tear came out of her eyes; her face looked in some trance, or a pain-induced meditation, not far from the people who do body suspension.
607c6a01ed91.t: Itanema mengisap jari-jari yang melepuh di salah satu tangannya sebentar, mengeluarkannya saat jari-jari itu sembuh sepenuhnya. Ia lalu kembali mencurahkan perhatiannya ke perapian, mengambil sosis yang mendidih dari api dan menggigitnya. Uap panas keluar dari mulutnya seolah ia sedang mengembuskan asap cerutu, tetapi ia tampaknya cukup bertekad untuk memakannya. Bahkan tidak setetes air mata pun keluar dari matanya; wajahnya tampak dalam semacam trans, atau meditasi akibat rasa sakit, tidak jauh dari orang-orang yang melakukan suspensi tubuh.

63bed38cff18.en: Harry laughed with a bright smile alongside the cheery villagers’ shouts as the banjo player went off on a drunk solo—perhaps for just a moment, he felt as if he really had grown up in a Sanbi village somewhere, or perhaps he wished it. As the carriage kept chugging along the main road, he placed his hand over his belly to appease his aching bladder, also noticing something by the side of the road after the bonfire. There were a few empty benches against the wall of a store, while above it, the words The Dead Wozen Village Bar was painted up on the wall, lit up by two nearby fost stone lamps trying to compensate for the faded paint and moss growing in the building*.* I guessed right! Harry had built a solid mental map of the shared stops to Fishing Tree. This stop was on the easternmost edge of the Sanbi kingdom’s downward triangular shape, one stop away from what had to be a boat transfer due to a river.
63bed38cff18.t: Harry tertawa dengan senyum cerah bersama teriakan para penduduk desa yang ceria saat pemain banjo melakukan solo yang mabuk—mungkin hanya sesaat, ia merasa seolah ia benar-benar tumbuh besar di sebuah desa Sanbi di suatu tempat, atau mungkin ia berharap begitu. Saat kereta terus melaju di sepanjang jalan utama, ia meletakkan tangannya di perutnya untuk meredakan kandung kemihnya yang sakit, sekaligus memperhatikan sesuatu di pinggir jalan setelah api unggun. Ada beberapa bangku kosong di dinding sebuah toko, sementara di atasnya, tulisan The Dead Wozen Village Bar dicat di dinding, diterangi dua lampu fost stone di dekatnya yang berusaha mengimbangi cat yang pudar dan lumut yang tumbuh di bangunan itu*.* Tebakanku benar! Harry sudah membangun peta mental yang mantap tentang pemberhentian-pemberhentian kereta tumpangan menuju Fishing Tree. Pemberhentian ini berada di tepi paling timur bentuk segitiga terbalik kerajaan Sanbi, satu pemberhentian sebelum sesuatu yang pasti tempat pindah ke perahu karena ada sungai.

650266e45a60.en: His brain could not believe what his eyes were seeing. What was supposed to be a glance from Harry turned out to be an open stare. “You—you okay?” he spoke softly; part of him didn’t want to disturb whatever she was doing.
650266e45a60.t: Otaknya tidak bisa memercayai apa yang dilihat matanya. Yang seharusnya hanya lirikan dari Harry berubah menjadi tatapan terang-terangan. “Kau—kau baik-baik saja?” katanya pelan; sebagian dirinya tidak ingin mengganggu apa pun yang sedang ia lakukan.

650ff2b83597.en: Another wave of sensation began emanating from the same tip lodged inside Harry, but this time it was numbness followed by a paralyzing feeling. Harry’s mind threw a master warning alert as the vivid memory of when something nasty was injected into his neck came to the forefront of his mind. The numbness is the same! Shit! Without thinking, he grabbed the lodged arrow and tried to pull it out with all the strength he had left. “AHHH!” Harry screamed in pain as the arrow got partly out before snapping in the middle. The tip of the arrow was still lodged in his flesh, still releasing whatever nasty concoction it contained. He took off, running deeper into the forest with his left hand, trying to feel ahead, but then he struck what had to be a large root and fell forward onto a bush.
650ff2b83597.t: Gelombang sensasi lain mulai memancar dari ujung yang sama yang menancap di dalam diri Harry, tetapi kali ini mati rasa disusul perasaan lumpuh. Pikiran Harry membunyikan alarm peringatan utama saat ingatan jelas tentang saat sesuatu yang berbahaya disuntikkan ke lehernya muncul di garis depan benaknya. Mati rasanya sama! Sial! Tanpa berpikir, ia meraih anak panah yang menancap itu dan mencoba mencabutnya dengan sisa tenaga yang ia punya. “AHHH!” Harry berteriak kesakitan saat anak panah itu sebagian keluar sebelum patah di tengah. Ujung anak panah itu masih menancap di dagingnya, masih melepaskan ramuan berbahaya apa pun yang dikandungnya. Ia berlari lebih dalam ke hutan dengan tangan kirinya, mencoba meraba ke depan, tetapi kemudian ia menabrak sesuatu yang pasti akar besar dan jatuh ke depan ke semak-semak.

66832c38f410.en: “I’dro’y’off’share’wago. Ya’go’fishi’tre—” Sinoi coughed like he had lung cancer, then spit another blob from the corner of his mouth. His eyes didn’t seem open at all—maybe the egua was controlling the whole thing after all?
66832c38f410.t: “Ku’tur’n’di’kre’tum’pang. Kau’ke’fishi’tre—” Sinoi batuk seolah terkena kanker paru-paru, lalu meludahkan gumpalan lain dari sudut mulutnya. Matanya tampaknya sama sekali tidak terbuka—mungkin memang egua itu yang mengendalikan semuanya?

6ab353927c62.en: Harry looked at the passing ground; if he were to jump off right now, it would probably hurt a lot. Inside his mind, a vision of him getting closer to the edge, pulling his dong out, and letting it rain in the wind seemed plausible. As he scooched closer to the edge to make that a reality, the ground rushing by beneath him and the unsteadiness of the carriage made that nearly impossible.
6ab353927c62.t: Harry memandang tanah yang lewat; kalau ia melompat turun sekarang, mungkin akan sangat sakit. Di dalam benaknya, bayangan dirinya mendekati tepi, mengeluarkan anunya, dan membiarkannya hujan tertiup angin tampak masuk akal. Saat ia bergeser lebih dekat ke tepi untuk mewujudkannya, tanah yang melesat di bawahnya dan goyahnya kereta membuat hal itu hampir mustahil.

6ae654f9786c.en: Sinoi was reactionless to it—perhaps some folk stop giving shits to the fact that soul death is coming sooner rather than later for them. Suddenly, a short double high-pitched call echoed from the forest as they rode on that dark road. Coincidentally, Sinoi began slowing down to a stop, yelling out, “L’ve’bag’er’n’G’pee!”
6ae654f9786c.t: Sinoi tidak bereaksi—mungkin sebagian orang berhenti peduli pada kenyataan bahwa kematian jiwa akan datang lebih cepat bagi mereka. Tiba-tiba, sebuah panggilan pendek bernada tinggi dua kali menggema dari hutan saat mereka melaju di jalan gelap itu. Kebetulan, Sinoi mulai memperlambat sampai berhenti, berteriak, “Ting’al’tas’di’sin’Sa’a’ken’cing!”

6da9afb7d54b.en: A sharp metallic bang on wood sounded off from deeper in the forest on the other side of the road. A whooshing sound flew by Harry, striking the tree he was resting against. His hand perused where the noise occurred and felt a long, thin, smooth stick by his head. Feather? An arrow?
6da9afb7d54b.t: Bunyi dentang logam yang tajam pada kayu terdengar dari bagian hutan yang lebih dalam di sisi lain jalan. Bunyi desing melesat melewati Harry, menghantam pohon tempat ia bersandar. Tangannya meraba tempat bunyi itu terjadi dan merasakan sebatang tongkat panjang, tipis, dan halus di dekat kepalanya. Bulu? Anak panah?

6f71591d2db2.en: Itanema, still silent, finished brooming the dirt to a pan, then threw it in the fire—rather than the trash.
6f71591d2db2.t: Itanema, masih diam, selesai menyapu kotoran ke serokan, lalu membuangnya ke api—alih-alih ke tempat sampah.

723af7bd70a9.en: “Get’in.” A jumble of tired words came out of Sinoi’s mouth as he kept on chewing on a wooden stick.
723af7bd70a9.t: “Nai’.” Kata-kata lelah yang campur aduk keluar dari mulut Sinoi sambil terus mengunyah sebatang tongkat kayu.

729682feb6e4.en: A splat sound, one of a leash hitting an animal’s tough hide, cut through the forest noises.
729682feb6e4.t: Bunyi cambukan, bunyi tali kekang yang menghantam kulit keras seekor hewan, memotong suara-suara hutan.

743fb1375378.en: Clearing his throat with a deep cough that sounded like he was coughing up his lungs, Sinoi spat a brownish substance from the corner of his mouth onto the moving ground that looked like a murderous blob, viciously wanting to swallow people. His chewing stick then started to move about his mouth as he chewed on it like a horse would chew hard candy. “I’will’dropya’off’fathe’away’—jus’relax’”
743fb1375378.t: Berdeham dengan batuk dalam yang terdengar seolah ia sedang membatukkan paru-parunya, Sinoi meludahkan zat kecokelatan dari sudut mulutnya ke tanah yang bergerak yang tampak seperti gumpalan pembunuh, yang dengan kejam ingin menelan orang-orang. Tongkat kunyahnya lalu mulai bergerak di dalam mulutnya saat ia mengunyahnya seperti kuda mengunyah permen keras. “Ku’turun’kau’jauhan—santai’aja’”

78f868b7d2f8.en: His stomach revolted at Arukia’s fuckery, growling at only getting back barely a piece left, with her girly perfume still wrecking the taste. Still, better than having nothing left. Harry then noticed the red lip mark she left on it—subconsciously, he wondered if the sandwich would taste any different as it neared his salivating mouth.
78f868b7d2f8.t: Perut Harry memberontak terhadap ulah sialan Arukia, menggeram karena hanya mendapat kembali sepotong kecil, dengan parfum femininnya masih merusak rasanya. Tetap saja, lebih baik daripada tidak tersisa apa-apa. Harry lalu memperhatikan bekas bibir merah yang ditinggalkannya—tanpa sadar, ia bertanya-tanya apakah sandwich itu akan terasa berbeda saat mendekati mulutnya yang mengeluarkan air liur.

7909c2565317.en: I-I guess so. Harry felt his bladder muscles about to rip, giving him no choice. He looked at the supposed muddy ground, but it didn’t seem too bad. Slowly stepping out of the carriage, his boots didn’t make the squishing sound he had presumed. He looked back at his bag in the dry carriage as his mind told him to pick it up. But what if I do lose it in the dark? The same ominous wired feeling lingered in his brain and chest, but his bladder overrode his inaction. With one careful step after another, he approached the vegetation on the side of the road and pulled out his junk, wetted from slightly pissing himself beforehand. Apparently, holding it in for so long made his bladder seem stuck at first, but with enough pressure, a torrential stream came out of his body; the overwhelming relief sensation spreading through his lower body was so good that he couldn’t stop himself from letting out a moan. Finally—
7909c2565317.t: A-aku rasa begitu. Harry merasakan otot kandung kemihnya hampir robek, tidak memberinya pilihan. Ia memandang tanah yang katanya berlumpur, tetapi tampaknya tidak terlalu buruk. Perlahan turun dari kereta, sepatu botnya tidak mengeluarkan bunyi becek seperti yang ia kira. Ia kembali memandang tasnya di kereta yang kering sementara pikirannya menyuruhnya mengambilnya. Tapi bagaimana kalau aku malah menghilangkannya dalam gelap? Perasaan tegang tidak menyenangkan yang sama membekas di otak dan dadanya, tetapi kandung kemihnya mengalahkan keraguannya. Dengan satu langkah hati-hati demi satu langkah, ia mendekati semak-semak di pinggir jalan dan mengeluarkan anunya, yang basah karena sedikit terkencing sebelumnya. Tampaknya, menahannya begitu lama membuat kandung kemihnya seperti macet pada awalnya, tetapi dengan tekanan yang cukup, aliran deras keluar dari tubuhnya; sensasi lega luar biasa yang menyebar ke tubuh bagian bawahnya begitu nikmat sampai ia tidak bisa menahan diri untuk mendesah. Akhirnya—

7afa45d5706c.en: The carriage kept moving along this darkening rough road, leaving the cluster of houses behind. Another carriage not far ahead coming in the opposite direction had a fost lamp on both front and back, illuminating the road brightly against the setting sun. It was larger than most carriages, with four eguas trotting pulling its chunky weight. It had many seats inside with extra ones on the ceiling, but there weren’t many people. Sinoi made a hustling noise as his hands dug deep into a pocket, taking out what appeared to be a wooden container about the size of a lighter. With a slight clicking noise, he slid his hand vertically on the side wooden gear to unlock the top, then slid the top to the side. He dumped what had to be salt from that contraption into a fost lamp by his feet, making it come alive too, and placing it by his side.
7afa45d5706c.t: Kereta itu terus bergerak di sepanjang jalan kasar yang semakin gelap ini, meninggalkan kelompok rumah itu di belakang. Kereta lain tak jauh di depan yang datang dari arah berlawanan memiliki lampu fost di depan dan belakangnya, menerangi jalan dengan terang melawan matahari yang terbenam. Kereta itu lebih besar daripada kebanyakan kereta, dengan empat egua berderap menarik bobotnya yang gemuk. Ada banyak kursi di dalamnya dengan kursi tambahan di atapnya, tetapi tidak banyak orang. Sinoi membuat bunyi berkeresek saat tangannya merogoh dalam-dalam ke saku, mengeluarkan sesuatu yang tampak seperti wadah kayu kira-kira seukuran pemantik. Dengan bunyi klik pelan, ia menggeser tangannya secara vertikal di roda gigi kayu di sampingnya untuk membuka kunci bagian atas, lalu menggeser bagian atas itu ke samping. Ia menuangkan sesuatu yang pasti garam dari alat itu ke lampu fost di dekat kakinya, membuatnya ikut menyala, dan meletakkannya di sampingnya.

7d31d5dea2ac.en: “What? I’m not the one in the wrong here. We could have gotten a raise instead of this useless guy being pandered!” Arukia, resting against the door, twirled her hair. With an annoyed sigh, she pulled the clothing covering her breasts slightly towards Harry—more teasing than revealing. “Next time, the questions will be tougher, so come prepared!” She disappeared towards the atrium.
7d31d5dea2ac.t: “Apa? Bukan aku yang salah di sini. Kita bisa saja dapat kenaikan gaji alih-alih orang tidak berguna ini dimanja!” Arukia, bersandar di pintu, memilin rambutnya. Dengan helaan napas kesal, ia menarik sedikit pakaian yang menutupi payudaranya ke arah Harry—lebih menggoda daripada memperlihatkan. “Lain kali, pertanyaannya akan lebih sulit, jadi datanglah dengan persiapan!” Ia menghilang ke arah atrium.

7d961ed8bc3e.en: Hugging Sora from the side, Eiri patted her head and spoke with a motherly tone, “That’s new coming from you—but you could have just said no to Harry instead of all of that. He won’t bite, right, Harry?”
7d961ed8bc3e.t: Memeluk Sora dari samping, Eiri menepuk kepalanya dan berbicara dengan nada keibuan, “Itu hal baru darimu—tapi kamu bisa saja bilang tidak ke Harry alih-alih semua itu. Dia tidak akan menggigit, kan, Harry?”

7ee8fd3376fb.en: “Thanks—ah, Sinoi.” Harry let out a constrained grunt as the egua’s canter made the carriage shake even more. Clenching his face as his bladder pinched with each bump, he tried to focus away from it by focusing on the village coming into sight ahead.
7ee8fd3376fb.t: “Terima kasih—ah, Sinoi.” Harry mengerang tertahan saat lari kencang egua membuat kereta berguncang lebih hebat. Mengernyitkan wajahnya saat kandung kemihnya tercubit di setiap guncangan, ia mencoba mengalihkan perhatian darinya dengan berfokus pada desa yang mulai terlihat di depan.

7ef609cc264f.en: Staring at his badge and seeing his name written near the glimmering thermometer-like apparatus when he touched his thumb on its base, Harry felt a sense of realness strike him. He looked back, hoping to see Eiri and Sora still, but it was for naught as he was already far away. The buildings looked different, but not too different from the ones in front of the castle door. Harry glanced at the signs and noticed some didn’t even have names written but just a logogram of what it was about. A mug of beer with a hearty-looking drumstick was carved in one of them. Tavern? OH! This one is a nari gel place? Harry saw another wooden carved sign, but this time it was a nari gel glass container, including a metal cast writing Manana’s Nari Shop into the cork—giving the sign a fancy-like vibe. Below it was an open door where he could peek inside for a second, seeing a wall of nari gels with various colors and things inside.
7ef609cc264f.t: Menatap lencananya dan melihat namanya tertulis di dekat alat mirip termometer yang berkilauan saat ia menyentuhkan jempolnya ke pangkalnya, Harry merasakan kenyataan menghantamnya. Ia menoleh ke belakang, berharap masih melihat Eiri dan Sora, tetapi sia-sia karena ia sudah jauh. Bangunan-bangunannya tampak berbeda, tetapi tidak terlalu berbeda dengan yang ada di depan pintu kastil. Harry melirik papan-papan nama dan memperhatikan sebagian bahkan tidak bertuliskan nama, hanya logogram tentang apa usaha itu. Segelas bir dengan paha ayam yang tampak lezat terukir di salah satunya. Kedai minum? OH! Yang ini toko nari gel? Harry melihat papan kayu berukir lainnya, tetapi kali ini berupa wadah kaca nari gel, termasuk tulisan logam cor Manana’s Nari Shop pada sumbatnya—memberi papan itu kesan mewah. Di bawahnya ada pintu terbuka tempat ia bisa mengintip ke dalam sebentar, melihat dinding penuh nari gel dengan berbagai warna dan benda di dalamnya.

7fd96b3a6b62.en: Winga mail—Hiromi! Harry smiled, making a higher-pitched agreement hum. “I forgot to ask Hiromi about it! He mentioned he would write to me too! Can I ask how to do it?”
7fd96b3a6b62.t: Winga mail—Hiromi! Harry tersenyum, bergumam setuju dengan nada lebih tinggi. “Aku lupa menanyakannya ke Hiromi! Dia bilang dia juga akan menulis surat padaku! Boleh aku tanya bagaimana caranya?”

81ccb0c3d909.en: Harry scratched his head as another embarrassed laugh came out of him. Wait—so that was a rejection too? I guess I’m getting used to it now. Harry took a deep breath of the outside air, arriving at a familiar tall door with a large jumping Sanbi fish carved and painted on it—that massive door was the only way in or out of the round walls encircling the castle grounds. A flashback passed through his mind as he stood in the same spot where Kibe handed over his badge. “Eiri—can I ask about my badge?”
81ccb0c3d909.t: Harry menggaruk kepalanya sementara tawa malu lagi keluar darinya. Tunggu—jadi itu juga penolakan? Kurasa sekarang aku mulai terbiasa. Harry menarik napas dalam-dalam menghirup udara luar, tiba di pintu tinggi yang familier dengan ikan Sanbi besar yang melompat terukir dan tercat di atasnya—pintu raksasa itu satu-satunya jalan masuk atau keluar dari tembok bundar yang mengelilingi lingkungan kastil. Kilas balik melintas di benaknya saat ia berdiri di tempat yang sama di mana Kibe menyerahkan lencananya. “Eiri—boleh aku tanya soal lencanaku?”

83852785a632.en: Sora grabbed the side of her long black and blue skirt. Her rosacea grew intense as her wavering eyes had something to say, but her tiny mouth seemed inept. Deeply bowing, it looked like she was on the verge of booking it at full speed back towards the castle, but perhaps being by Eiri gave her the courage, or outright convinced her beforehand, to remain close to Harry’s hungering eyes.
83852785a632.t: Sora memegang sisi rok panjangnya yang hitam dan biru. Rosacea-nya semakin hebat sementara matanya yang goyah punya sesuatu untuk dikatakan, tetapi mulut mungilnya tampak tak berdaya. Membungkuk dalam-dalam, ia tampak seolah di ambang kabur dengan kecepatan penuh kembali ke kastil, tetapi mungkin berada di samping Eiri memberinya keberanian, atau memang sudah meyakinkannya sebelumnya, untuk tetap dekat dengan mata Harry yang lapar.

847f0ed45d33.en: “My own lab soreno! Fucking, finally!” A familiar girly voice spoke right in front of Harry as if she was squatting in front of him.
847f0ed45d33.t: “Soreno percobaanku sendiri! Akhirnya, bangsat!” Suara feminin yang familier berbicara tepat di depan Harry seolah ia sedang berjongkok di depannya.

84e24f483525.en: “Sorry, but how far away is Fishing Tree?” Harry brought the map upfront, pointing right at the center of Sanbi Kingdom.
84e24f483525.t: “Maaf, tapi seberapa jauh Fishing Tree?” Harry menyodorkan peta itu ke depan, menunjuk tepat di tengah Kerajaan Sanbi.

86d804776e50.en: I hope this is it! Harry looked at the gloom in the sky growing closer. Wait—this is going to The Dead Wozen stop, so are we going to ride all the way there? We’re gonna be riding all night! Harry looked towards the dark forest around him. An eerie vibe hampered the thrill of discovery. “Sinoi?”
86d804776e50.t: Semoga ini tempatnya! Harry memandang cahaya redup di langit yang semakin dekat. Tunggu—ini menuju pemberhentian The Dead Wozen, jadi apa kita akan naik sampai ke sana? Kita bakal naik kereta semalaman! Harry memandang ke arah hutan gelap di sekelilingnya. Aura yang ganjil menghambat sensasi penemuan. “Sinoi?”

885f09245f58.en: Arukia took another large bite, leaving barely a bite-sized piece left. With one hand still hiding her chewing mouth, she brought the leftovers towards Harry’s mouth.
885f09245f58.t: Arukia menggigit besar lagi, nyaris tidak menyisakan sepotong seukuran satu gigitan. Dengan satu tangan masih menyembunyikan mulutnya yang mengunyah, ia mendekatkan sisa itu ke mulut Harry.

88b59f936219.en: Chapter II – Sanbi-Eye · Vol 2 - Lab Soreno · #HusbandOutWorld
88b59f936219.t: Bab II – Sanbi-Eye · Jilid 2 - Soreno Percobaan · #HusbandOutWorld

89adc2a456e4.en: Sora withdrew her head in shame. She would be a clump of carapace if she were an armadillo.
89adc2a456e4.t: Sora menarik kepalanya karena malu. Kalau ia trenggiling, ia pasti sudah menggulung jadi bola bersisik.

8dba8105e02d.en: “Don’t call her that!” Eiri laughed it off as she nodded her head towards the atrium.
8dba8105e02d.t: “Jangan panggil dia begitu!” Eiri tertawa santai sambil mengangguk ke arah atrium.

8e8f1abb30ac.en: Itanema didn’t seem to flinch or care much about the skin of her fingers sizzling like the meat cuts roasting over the fire.
8e8f1abb30ac.t: Itanema tampaknya tidak tersentak atau terlalu peduli dengan kulit jari-jarinya yang berdesis seperti potongan daging yang dipanggang di atas api.

97b4421dba42.en: The carriage entered the village. A cluster of cheaply put palisades defended groups of homes surrounding the main street, where a few shops and taverns were packed closely together in a widening straight road. In the center of the road, a small town square, or, more accurately, a village square, was accented with a giant bonfire contrasting the white light of the fost stones.
97b4421dba42.t: Kereta itu memasuki desa. Sekumpulan pagar kayu yang dipasang asal-asalan melindungi kelompok-kelompok rumah yang mengelilingi jalan utama, tempat beberapa toko dan kedai minum berjejal rapat di jalan lurus yang melebar. Di tengah jalan, sebuah alun-alun kota kecil, atau lebih tepatnya alun-alun desa, dihiasi api unggun raksasa yang kontras dengan cahaya putih fost stone.

99d4907a6925.en: Putting his long Joe away quickly, he kept pissing in his underwear and his pants were getting wet as his feet took off after Sinoi. “SINOI! MY BAG! PLEASE STOP! SINOI!” Harry continued running towards the carriage, but his feet struck something, and he came crashing down forward, tasting the fresh earthiness as his mouth, face, and eyes were plastered with moist dirt. He pushed himself forward with burning eyes to stand up and run again. His heart felt like it was about to explode as the same old feeling of drinking an entire pot of coffee surged even stronger than before, taking away his breath. He tried to tap into that raw energy to keep running at full throttle, but then his legs gave in. Once again, his whole body slumped forward like a tree falling in the woods.
99d4907a6925.t: Cepat-cepat menyimpan anunya yang panjang, ia terus kencing di celana dalamnya dan celananya basah saat kakinya berlari mengejar Sinoi. “SINOI! TASKU! TOLONG BERHENTI! SINOI!” Harry terus berlari ke arah kereta, tetapi kakinya tersandung sesuatu, dan ia jatuh tersungkur ke depan, mengecap rasa tanah yang segar karena mulut, wajah, dan matanya berlumuran tanah lembap. Ia mendorong dirinya maju dengan mata perih untuk berdiri dan berlari lagi. Jantungnya terasa akan meledak saat perasaan lama yang sama seperti meminum sepoci penuh kopi melonjak lebih kuat dari sebelumnya, merenggut napasnya. Ia mencoba memanfaatkan energi mentah itu untuk terus berlari dengan kecepatan penuh, tetapi kemudian kakinya menyerah. Sekali lagi, seluruh tubuhnya roboh ke depan seperti pohon tumbang di hutan.

9aa4b116b35e.t: “Pa’?” Sinoi menyembur balik, masih tak bergerak.

9d50c46bdbc8.en: The same odd short double high-pitched call echoed in the forest again, but it seemed louder and closer this time. Goosebumps rushed through Harry as he made himself small, trying to retreat from the source. His teary, dilating eyes made it a tad easier to see the path versus the forest, but he couldn’t see the details of the rough ground anymore as it was way too dark. What should I do? What should I do? He tried to mask his intense breathing by opening a large, wide mouth, but one could still hear the panic swelling with each breath. Cold sweat poured from every pore in his body as he continued to walk backward, clashing his back against a tree.
9d50c46bdbc8.t: Panggilan pendek bernada tinggi dua kali yang aneh itu menggema di hutan lagi, tetapi kali ini terdengar lebih keras dan lebih dekat. Bulu kuduk Harry berdiri saat ia mengecilkan dirinya, mencoba mundur dari sumber suara itu. Matanya yang berlinang dan membesar membuatnya sedikit lebih mudah membedakan jalan dan hutan, tetapi ia tidak bisa lagi melihat detail tanah yang kasar karena terlalu gelap. Apa yang harus kulakukan? Apa yang harus kulakukan? Ia mencoba menyamarkan napasnya yang memburu dengan membuka mulutnya lebar-lebar, tetapi orang masih bisa mendengar kepanikan yang membengkak di setiap napas. Keringat dingin mengucur dari setiap pori di tubuhnya saat ia terus berjalan mundur, menabrakkan punggungnya ke sebuah pohon.

9ef993490e4c.en: The sound of the egua trotting merged with the usual creaks of the carriage as it gathered speed. Meanwhile, the fost lamp in the carriage left the darkness to swallow Harry.
9ef993490e4c.t: Bunyi derap egua menyatu dengan derit biasa kereta saat kereta itu menambah kecepatan. Sementara itu, lampu fost di kereta meninggalkan kegelapan untuk menelan Harry.

a0822851a832.en: Harry could hear multiple footsteps coming close by, slowing down as if searching for him—for sure, there was more than one person. He tried to stop breathing, but the feeling of suffocation overrode his power and forced him to take another anguished breath. I wanna go home! I just want to go home! He closed his eyes and tried not to listen to the footsteps growing closer and closer, but that’s all his mind focused on. Curling up in a fetal position, at least he thought his body was doing it; tears ran down his eyes and into the moist ground beneath him. A sniff involuntarily came out as the tears grew into a sob. Eiri! Please help me! Eiri’s image came to Harry’s mind as the footsteps passed close by.
a0822851a832.t: Harry bisa mendengar banyak langkah kaki mendekat, melambat seolah sedang mencarinya—jelas ada lebih dari satu orang. Ia mencoba berhenti bernapas, tetapi perasaan tercekik mengalahkan kekuatannya dan memaksanya menarik napas tersiksa lagi. Aku mau pulang! Aku cuma mau pulang! Ia memejamkan matanya dan berusaha tidak mendengarkan langkah-langkah kaki yang semakin dekat dan semakin dekat, tetapi hanya itu yang menjadi fokus pikirannya. Meringkuk dalam posisi janin, setidaknya ia kira tubuhnya melakukannya; air mata mengalir dari matanya ke tanah lembap di bawahnya. Isakan keluar tanpa sadar saat air matanya berubah menjadi tangisan. Eiri! Tolong aku! Bayangan Eiri muncul di benak Harry saat langkah-langkah kaki itu lewat di dekatnya.

a0de54d949f9.en: Feeling the road getting bumpier again as the carriage exited the modest-looking village, an eerie sensation came back to him as he stared into the darkness of the forests. The stabbing pain in his bladder grew more intense, putting more pressure on a decisive action. “Sinoi—sorry, but when can we stop? Urgh—I really need to pee!” A bit of pee came out as he clenched his detrusor muscles even more, begging them to be a bit more patient.
a0de54d949f9.t: Merasakan jalan kembali bergelombang saat kereta keluar dari desa yang tampak sederhana itu, sensasi ganjil kembali kepadanya saat ia menatap kegelapan hutan. Rasa sakit menusuk di kandung kemihnya semakin hebat, semakin menuntut tindakan tegas. “Sinoi—maaf, tapi kapan kita bisa berhenti? Urgh—aku benar-benar harus kencing!” Sedikit air kencing keluar saat ia semakin mengencangkan otot detrusornya, memohon agar otot itu sedikit lebih sabar.

a0eeab240748.en: Drinking from where the lip mark stained the glass was, Harry could taste the defeat as he saw Arukia swing her tantalizing hips towards the door that separated the atrium and kitchen.
a0eeab240748.t: Minum dari tempat bekas bibir itu menodai gelas, Harry bisa merasakan kekalahan saat ia melihat Arukia mengayunkan pinggulnya yang menggoda ke arah pintu yang memisahkan atrium dan dapur.

a275d8650425.en: A band of six people led the party with loud live music, and a single girl with an unnaturally bulged throat sang away a cheery song that had to be medieval bluegrass. The city folk with their fancy life don’t have nothin’ on our way of life! City girls salivate over sapphire balls! But we village girls never left our mates with blue balls. The crowd sang the chorus outright perfectly. They joyfully danced to the fast rhythm, almost trying to outdo the musicians’ energy.
a275d8650425.t: Sebuah band beranggotakan enam orang memimpin pesta dengan musik langsung yang keras, dan seorang gadis dengan tenggorokan yang menggembung secara tidak wajar menyanyikan lagu ceria yang pasti bluegrass abad pertengahan. Orang kota dengan hidup mewahnya tak ada apa-apanya dibanding cara hidup kita! Gadis kota ngiler melihat bola sapphire! Tapi kami gadis desa tak pernah biarkan bola pasangan kami membiru. Kerumunan menyanyikan bagian refrainnya dengan sempurna. Mereka menari gembira mengikuti irama yang cepat, hampir berusaha mengalahkan energi para musisi.

a2873f6bb369.en: The carriage veered off to the right, disappearing and taking the white light of the fost lamp with it. Sinoi never looked back.
a2873f6bb369.t: Kereta itu berbelok ke kanan, menghilang dan membawa serta cahaya putih lampu fost. Sinoi tidak pernah menoleh ke belakang.

a3ddc4f2e315.en: Harry hid himself behind the tree, then tried to peek towards where the arrow came from, but didn’t see anything. Is someone hunting me? Was Sinoi with them? Wait! Did Eiri know about this too? Harry looked around, hoping to see anything or anyone else, but it was even darker inside the forest. I have to get out! Harry pushed himself forward, trying not to make noise as he walked deeper into the woods, away from whoever or whatever that was. With his hand moving outwardly, he was trying to find another tree to hide behind.
a3ddc4f2e315.t: Harry bersembunyi di balik pohon, lalu mencoba mengintip ke arah datangnya anak panah, tetapi tidak melihat apa-apa. Apa ada yang memburuku? Apa Sinoi bersama mereka? Tunggu! Apa Eiri juga tahu soal ini? Harry memandang sekeliling, berharap melihat apa pun atau siapa pun, tetapi di dalam hutan bahkan lebih gelap lagi. Aku harus keluar! Harry mendorong dirinya maju, berusaha tidak bersuara saat berjalan lebih dalam ke hutan, menjauh dari siapa pun atau apa pun itu. Dengan tangan terulur ke depan, ia mencoba mencari pohon lain untuk bersembunyi.

a590e3b8ec31.en: As if he had reclaimed a piece of himself, Harry grabbed his badge, lightly touching Sora’s fingers in the process, making her blush even more—if that was even possible. “Thanks, Sora!” Looking at his badge, he placed his thumb on the base of the thermometer-like apparatus, making a glimmering light appear on the thinner portion. He looked back at Sora with a broad smile, showing the glimmering light to her.
a590e3b8ec31.t: Seolah mendapatkan kembali sepotong dirinya, Harry mengambil lencananya, menyentuh pelan jari-jari Sora dalam prosesnya, membuatnya semakin merona—kalau itu memang masih mungkin. “Terima kasih, Sora!” Memandang lencananya, ia meletakkan jempolnya di pangkal alat mirip termometer itu, membuat cahaya berkilauan muncul di bagian yang lebih tipis. Ia kembali memandang Sora dengan senyum lebar, menunjukkan cahaya berkilauan itu kepadanya.

a75dd37fc828.en: Harry silently watched Arukia take small sips of a full glass of water. Part of him wanted to ask for it too, but the other part internally loudly exclaimed, Nope—you don’t deserve it.
a75dd37fc828.t: Harry diam-diam memperhatikan Arukia menyesap sedikit demi sedikit segelas penuh air. Sebagian dirinya ingin memintanya juga, tetapi bagian lain berseru keras di dalam hati, Tidak—kau tidak pantas mendapatkannya.

a938b9c7305b.en: “This fucking thing!” A girly voice very loudly whispered from the same direction where the sharp metallic bang sounded off. Harry felt a familiar tone to it but couldn’t pinpoint who it was.
a938b9c7305b.t: “Benda sialan ini!” Suara feminin berbisik sangat keras dari arah yang sama dengan bunyi dentang logam yang tajam itu. Harry merasakan nada yang familier darinya tetapi tidak bisa memastikan siapa.

ac0e18ca188e.en: “With due respect, please finish him already.” A male voice pleaded to the girl, but it didn’t seem remorseful. Instead, its deadpan delivery sounded like he was trying to get this over with. “We are diverging from the schedule.”
ac0e18ca188e.t: “Dengan segala hormat, tolong segera habisi dia.” Suara pria memohon kepada gadis itu, tetapi tidak terdengar menyesal. Sebaliknya, penyampaiannya yang datar terdengar seperti ia ingin cepat-cepat menyelesaikannya. “Kita menyimpang dari jadwal.”

aea993389ca4.en: “I’DON’CAR’. G’PEE!” Sinoi cut through Harry’s cowardly call.
aea993389ca4.t: “GA’PE’U’I. SA’A’KEN’CING!” Sinoi memotong panggilan pengecut Harry.

af51530dca3a.en: With nothing but an embarrassed laugh, Harry walked together with the two maids out into the sunny afternoon. He felt the sunshine play warmly with his skin as the same breeze of sea mixed with fish ruffled the grass and plants. Meanwhile, a butterfly feeling tickled his inner gut—perhaps it was a hunger for food, hunger for Sora, or both.
af51530dca3a.t: Hanya dengan tawa malu, Harry berjalan bersama kedua pelayan itu keluar ke sore yang cerah. Ia merasakan sinar matahari bermain hangat dengan kulitnya sementara angin laut bercampur bau ikan yang sama mengusik rumput dan tanaman. Sementara itu, perasaan seperti kupu-kupu menggelitik bagian dalam perutnya—mungkin itu lapar akan makanan, lapar akan Sora, atau keduanya.

b43d62ca262f.en: “You’re still doing that? Argh! The trash is literally over here!” Arukia clicked her tongue loudly this time as Itanema pulled on the handle to wash her hands. Arukia’s tone grew taut as she spoke over the angry gush of water roaring in the kitchen, “Fine! I will tell her that you washed your hands this time.”
b43d62ca262f.t: “Kau masih melakukan itu? Argh! Tempat sampahnya jelas-jelas ada di sini!” Arukia berdecak keras kali ini saat Itanema menarik tuas untuk mencuci tangannya. Nada Arukia menjadi tegang saat ia berbicara melampaui semburan air marah yang menderu di dapur, “Baiklah! Akan kubilang padanya kau mencuci tanganmu kali ini.”

b52f665e9394.en: Doesn’t that hurt? Harry kept looking at her blistering fingers as she kept turning the delicious-looking and delicious-smelling meats.
b52f665e9394.t: Apa itu tidak sakit? Harry terus memandangi jari-jarinya yang melepuh saat ia terus membalik daging-daging yang tampak lezat dan berbau lezat itu.

b6f46c7960fc.en: Itanema glanced at Arukia, and Harry, then back at her hands without saying anything. Her neutral expression didn’t appear to have much to say either as she pushed on the handle to stop the angry gush of water, bringing a silence to the room.
b6f46c7960fc.t: Itanema melirik Arukia, dan Harry, lalu kembali memandang tangannya tanpa mengatakan apa-apa. Raut netralnya juga tampaknya tidak punya banyak hal untuk dikatakan saat ia mendorong tuas untuk menghentikan semburan air marah, membawa keheningan ke ruangan.

ba0702cba24f.en: The vicious girly giggles grew quieter.
ba0702cba24f.t: Cekikikan feminin yang keji itu semakin pelan.

bbc5b26a1d52.en: Check, map? Harry scooched back on his seat and rested his brownish furry leather bag on his lap. Untying the strap in the center, he opened it up. He saw a collection of goodies inside. Two journals with leather strap cover, a folded heavy-paper pamphlet, a writing feather, a somewhat-small leather water bottle filled to the brim, one tube of ink corked tightly, a wax seal toolkit to make blue Sanbi wax seals, Sanbi mail postcard-sized envelopes—whitish in color, and a leather purse. Pulling out the purse, it felt somewhat heavy. Hmmm*—kinda looks like what Hiromi had?* Once he opened it, he saw nothing but a bunch of pearls wrapped in the same golden medal. No amethysts? Oh well. Harry looked for a spot in his bag to secure his badge but found none. I guess I will just put it with my money before I lose it. He placed his badge into the purse; Harry closed it tightly, then slipped it back into the bag. Now that I think about it—I thought money came in bills! Like paper-shape, greenish—oh yeah! There were cents too! Like in the shape of round metal things.
bbc5b26a1d52.t: Lihat, peta? Harry bergeser kembali ke kursinya dan meletakkan tas kulit berbulu kecokelatannya di pangkuannya. Membuka ikatan tali di tengahnya, ia membukanya. Ia melihat sekumpulan barang bagus di dalamnya. Dua jurnal bersampul tali kulit, pamflet kertas tebal yang dilipat, sebuah pena bulu, botol air kulit yang agak kecil terisi penuh, satu tabung tinta yang disumbat rapat, perlengkapan segel lilin untuk membuat segel lilin Sanbi biru, amplop Sanbi mail seukuran kartu pos—berwarna keputihan, dan sebuah dompet kulit. Mengeluarkan dompet itu, terasa agak berat. Hmmm*—agak mirip dengan punya Hiromi?* Begitu ia membukanya, ia tidak melihat apa-apa selain sekumpulan pearl yang dibalut medali emas yang sama. Tidak ada amethyst? Ya sudahlah. Harry mencari tempat di tasnya untuk mengamankan lencananya tetapi tidak menemukannya. Kurasa aku taruh saja bersama uangku sebelum hilang. Ia memasukkan lencananya ke dalam dompet; Harry menutupnya rapat, lalu memasukkannya kembali ke tas. Sekarang setelah kupikir-pikir—kukira uang itu berbentuk lembaran! Seperti berbentuk kertas, kehijauan—oh iya! Ada sen juga! Berbentuk benda logam bundar.

bd606b703f1b.en: With a shameful shake of the head, Sora seemingly refused to make eye contact, leaving Harry to hang like a sheet being dried in the wind.
bd606b703f1b.t: Dengan gelengan malu, Sora tampaknya menolak melakukan kontak mata, membiarkan Harry menggantung seperti seprai yang dijemur di angin.

bdd913d1e4f4.en: “Really? Are you trying to get a harem by pursuing her too?” Eiri smirked with mischievous laughter as she propped the kitchen door open. “Itanema does like it hot and steamy more than anyone I’ve seen!”
