bdd913d1e4f4.t: “Serius? Kamu mau bikin harem dengan mengejar dia juga?” Eiri menyeringai dengan tawa nakal sambil menahan pintu dapur tetap terbuka. “Itanema memang suka yang panas dan beruap lebih dari siapa pun yang pernah kulihat!”

c044496eafef.en: “What? I’m not going to tell you as you go! You’re the Sanbi-eye!” Arukia’s frown and pout looked like her tolerance for his stupidity was quickly drying up. She took another bite, but this time she chomped at least half of what was left, hiding away her chewing mouth behind her hand.
c044496eafef.t: “Apa? Aku tidak akan memberitahumu sambil jalan! Kau kan Sanbi-eye!” Kerutan dahi dan cemberut Arukia tampak seolah kesabarannya terhadap kebodohan Harry cepat mengering. Ia menggigit lagi, tetapi kali ini ia melahap setidaknya setengah dari yang tersisa, menyembunyikan mulutnya yang mengunyah di balik tangannya.

c6b3e634b4b6.en: “Huh?” Eiri elbowed Harry. “Maybe you have a chance on the harem after all—if you put her as the primary.”
c6b3e634b4b6.t: “Hah?” Eiri menyikut Harry. “Mungkin kamu memang punya peluang soal harem—kalau kamu menjadikannya yang utama.”

c9ec5c151f40.en: “Wa’?” Sinoi replied in a short burst of wakefulness, his tone seeming more annoyed than before.
c9ec5c151f40.t: “Pa’?” jawab Sinoi dalam semburan singkat kesadaran, nadanya tampak lebih kesal dari sebelumnya.

cbd03a9dbe76.en: I drop you off the share wagon. You go—fish tree? The difficulty of that decryption was a bit too high for Harry’s ears. “Fish tree?”
cbd03a9dbe76.t: Kuturunkan di kereta tumpangan. Kau ke—fish tree? Tingkat kesulitan dekripsi yang itu agak terlalu tinggi untuk telinga Harry. “Fish tree?”

cf7421223cb8.en: Another whooshing sound came through, but this time it didn’t miss. It struck Harry from the back right between the clavicle and scapula of his right shoulder. The arrow lodged itself deep in the muscle, rupturing tendons.
cf7421223cb8.t: Bunyi desing lain datang, tetapi kali ini tidak meleset. Anak panah itu menghantam Harry dari belakang tepat di antara tulang selangka dan tulang belikat bahu kanannya. Anak panah itu menancap dalam di otot, memutuskan tendon.

d1c0d9019fe9.en: I will drop you off farther away—just relax? Harry just gained a level in his decryption skills. “Ahh—thanks? Oh, Eiri said you would give extra details too?”
d1c0d9019fe9.t: Kuturunkan kau lebih jauh—santai saja? Harry baru saja naik satu level dalam kemampuan dekripsinya. “Ahh—terima kasih? Oh, Eiri bilang kau juga akan memberikan detail tambahan?”

d1c5e706c794.en: “ARGH!” Harry screamed in pain as his shoulder made a popping sound. His right arm grew weak, and he couldn’t lift it properly anymore. He tried but was met with more popping sounds as hot, aching pain radiated from deep in his shoulder and into his neck and right arm. The pain conflicted with a sudden wave of cool, refreshing sensation emanating from the tip of the arrow lodged inside him. That weird sensation began spreading through his shoulder.
d1c5e706c794.t: “ARGH!” Harry berteriak kesakitan saat bahunya berbunyi pop. Lengan kanannya melemah, dan ia tidak bisa mengangkatnya dengan benar lagi. Ia mencoba tetapi disambut lebih banyak bunyi pop saat rasa sakit yang panas dan nyeri memancar dari dalam bahunya ke leher dan lengan kanannya. Rasa sakit itu bertentangan dengan gelombang sensasi sejuk dan segar yang tiba-tiba memancar dari ujung anak panah yang menancap di dalam dirinya. Sensasi aneh itu mulai menyebar ke seluruh bahunya.

d23aa0066036.en: “It’s easy! Just find an embassy, and they will take care of you!” Eiri pointed at Harry’s badge. “That’s why I told you not to lose that, or you’re gonna be boned.” Eiri chuckled. “Like, really boned! Not the good kind of boning either!”
d23aa0066036.t: “Gampang! Cari saja kedutaan, dan mereka akan mengurusmu!” Eiri menunjuk lencana Harry. “Makanya aku bilang jangan sampai hilang, atau kamu bakal dientot habis-habisan.” Eiri terkekeh. “Maksudku, benar-benar dientot! Bukan entot yang enak juga!”

d3314d399ad6.en: Harry’s reddened, watering eyes still had dirt rubbing against his irises. Clearing it again, he focused on the dying sky switching from a reddish-purple-orange into a greenish blue hue. Everything else was covered by darkness. He felt a brisk wind pass by, chilling his scratched arms and the tears pouring down his face. His hearing tuned to every little sound around him. The whistle of the wind against the rustles of the leaves and the animal calls in the night seemed to be taunting him, waiting for him to break down in tears and call for his mommy.
d3314d399ad6.t: Mata Harry yang memerah dan berair masih kemasukan tanah yang menggesek irisnya. Membersihkannya lagi, ia berfokus pada langit yang memudar yang berganti dari merah-ungu-jingga menjadi biru kehijauan. Segala sesuatu yang lain tertutup kegelapan. Ia merasakan angin dingin lewat, membuat lengannya yang tergores dan air mata yang mengalir di wajahnya terasa dingin. Pendengarannya menangkap setiap bunyi kecil di sekitarnya. Siulan angin di antara desir dedaunan dan panggilan hewan di malam hari tampak mengejeknya, menunggunya menangis tersedu-sedu dan memanggil ibunya.

d68be10aa14f.en: Harry was seated silently in the kitchen, making ASMR sounds as his teeth ripped apart the crunchy multigrain bread of a meaty sandwich. His palate was pleased from no longer being bombarded by strong alcohol, instead tasting the leafy greens contrasting the spiciness and saltiness of a nice chunk of meat loaded inside—it had a cured pork-like taste, chewy texture to it, but it wasn’t overly salty. Everything seemed quiet and peaceful, at least until a certain maid by the name of Arukia burst through the swinging door with teapots and mugs, dropped them in the large sink, looked around the room, then invited herself to sit right by Harry. She approached so close that he could smell her slightly bubblegum-with-grape perfume—very girly, yes, but at the same time, it was kinda ruining his tasty sandwich.
d68be10aa14f.t: Harry duduk diam di dapur, mengeluarkan bunyi-bunyi ASMR saat giginya mengoyak roti multigrain yang renyah dari sebuah sandwich daging. Langit-langit mulutnya senang karena tidak lagi dibombardir alkohol keras, malah mencicipi sayuran hijau yang kontras dengan pedas dan asinnya sepotong daging yang enak di dalamnya—rasanya seperti daging babi yang diawetkan, teksturnya kenyal, tetapi tidak terlalu asin. Semuanya tampak tenang dan damai, setidaknya sampai seorang pelayan tertentu bernama Arukia menerobos pintu ayun dengan teko dan gelas-gelas, menjatuhkannya ke wastafel besar, memandang sekeliling ruangan, lalu dengan seenaknya duduk tepat di samping Harry. Ia mendekat begitu dekat sampai Harry bisa mencium parfumnya yang agak beraroma permen karet dan anggur—sangat feminin, memang, tetapi pada saat yang sama, agak merusak sandwich-nya yang lezat.

d8b54b66d5a1.en: A vicious girly laugh emanated from behind Harry, making its way towards him.
d8b54b66d5a1.t: Tawa feminin yang keji terdengar dari belakang Harry, mendekat ke arahnya.

dae08eb2a43b.en: A tree branch smacked Harry in the face, forcing him to retreat towards the center of the carriage. I thought the road was straight? Harry wiped away the scratches and leaves on his face. The narrow road made the forest creepier, as if it was ready to jump on him at any second. Harry then jumped in his seat when a cluster of wingas flew from off a nearby tree, screaming at the top of their lungs. His heart pounded as quickly as the live music he heard before. This wired energy feeling inside him grew more real, trying to tell him something, but he just couldn’t figure out what.
dae08eb2a43b.t: Sebuah dahan pohon menampar wajah Harry, memaksanya mundur ke tengah kereta. Kukira jalannya lurus? Harry menyeka goresan dan dedaunan dari wajahnya. Jalan yang sempit itu membuat hutan semakin menyeramkan, seolah siap menerkamnya kapan saja. Harry lalu terlonjak di kursinya saat sekelompok winga terbang dari pohon di dekatnya, memekik sekuat paru-parunya. Jantungnya berdebar secepat musik langsung yang ia dengar tadi. Perasaan energi tegang di dalam dirinya ini semakin nyata, berusaha memberitahunya sesuatu, tetapi ia tidak bisa memahaminya.

db1fa803d660.en: He looked around, trying to transform the unknown into know.
db1fa803d660.t: Ia memandang sekeliling, mencoba mengubah yang tidak diketahui menjadi diketahui.

dc82e80bb5cd.en: “Hey, Sinoi! Take good care of my Harry! I will do the same for Itanema too!” Eiri exclaimed from afar, waving a friendly goodbye.
dc82e80bb5cd.t: “Hei, Sinoi! Jaga Harry-ku baik-baik! Aku juga akan melakukan hal yang sama untuk Itanema!” seru Eiri dari jauh, melambai pamit dengan ramah.

df8bbb23ad40.en: Harry nodded with a smile from ear to ear. Feeling like a bird about to jump the nest, he walked towards the carriage Eiri pointed at. That’s kinda old. The carriage looked like the oldest of all the carriages he had seen passing by, even more so than another parked nearby. It looked like it had survived at least three wars—world wars! That’s huge! I thought they were the same size as horses! The egua pulling the cart seemed to be taken good care of, at least based on its shiny and voluptuous mane. An old-looking person was up front, holding the coachwhip to control the horse-like mammal. “Hi, Sinoi!” Harry said to the old man, who looked like he was about to fall asleep—or already deeply sleeping.
df8bbb23ad40.t: Harry mengangguk dengan senyum dari telinga ke telinga. Merasa seperti burung yang akan melompat dari sarang, ia berjalan menuju kereta yang ditunjuk Eiri. Itu agak tua. Kereta itu tampak paling tua di antara semua kereta yang ia lihat lewat, bahkan lebih tua daripada kereta lain yang diparkir di dekatnya. Kereta itu tampak seolah sudah selamat dari setidaknya tiga perang—perang dunia! Besar sekali! Kukira ukurannya sama dengan kuda! Egua yang menarik kereta itu tampaknya dirawat dengan baik, setidaknya kalau dilihat dari surainya yang mengilap dan lebat. Seseorang yang tampak tua ada di depan, memegang cambuk kusir untuk mengendalikan mamalia mirip kuda itu. “Halo, Sinoi!” kata Harry kepada pria tua itu, yang tampak seperti akan tertidur—atau sudah tidur nyenyak.

e012319bacfa.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 3: Harry waves toward a village at dusk where people gather around a campfire.
e012319bacfa.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 3: Harry melambai ke arah sebuah desa saat senja di mana orang-orang berkumpul mengelilingi api unggun.

e32dc5391ae3.en: Harry, with sauce on his lips, looked towards the closed door, then back at Itanema behind him. I wonder if I can ask her for another sandwich. He saw her struggling to turn over the hunks of meat, then using her bare hands to help flip the meat.
e32dc5391ae3.t: Harry, dengan saus di bibirnya, memandang pintu yang tertutup, lalu kembali ke Itanema di belakangnya. Aku penasaran apa aku boleh minta sandwich lagi padanya. Ia melihatnya bersusah payah membalik potongan-potongan daging, lalu memakai tangan kosongnya untuk membantu membalik daging itu.

e7c986a2ab9b.en: The Dead Wozen? That’s the tavern Hiromi met Yacamim! Harry’s eyes lit up, seeing a shared wagon stop towards the eastern edge of the map. With a broad smile, as he looked at how to get there from Sanbi Castle, he counted the cost to be nine pearls, and shared wagons were passing by every day. Cool! It’s on the way to Fishing Tree too!
e7c986a2ab9b.t: The Dead Wozen? Itu kedai minum tempat Hiromi bertemu Yacamim! Mata Harry berbinar, melihat sebuah pemberhentian kereta tumpangan di dekat tepi timur peta. Dengan senyum lebar, sambil melihat cara ke sana dari Kastil Sanbi, ia menghitung biayanya sembilan pearl, dan kereta tumpangan lewat setiap hari. Keren! Itu juga searah dengan Fishing Tree!

e89d272dfb1b.en: Meanwhile, the egua’s autopilot kept marching along this empty narrower rough road while Sinoi kept on chewing his mostly gone stick, looking even more immobile than before.
e89d272dfb1b.t: Sementara itu, autopilot egua terus berbaris di sepanjang jalan kasar yang lebih sempit dan kosong ini sementara Sinoi terus mengunyah tongkatnya yang hampir habis, tampak lebih tak bergerak dari sebelumnya.

ebb0fd767226.en: She placed her right hand right over her fun valley and spoke softly with a half-smile. “Guess right, and you can take a closer peek.”
ebb0fd767226.t: Ia meletakkan tangan kanannya tepat di atas lembah kesenangannya dan berbicara lembut dengan setengah senyum. “Tebak dengan benar, dan kau boleh mengintip lebih dekat.”

ec2a22ff7aaf.en: “Celerino Sanbi Royal.” Itanema promptly replied like a reflex rather than a memory. She kept brooming the dirt towards a corner with a slow but steady rhythm.
ec2a22ff7aaf.t: “Celerino Sanbi Royal.” Itanema langsung menjawab seperti refleks alih-alih ingatan. Ia terus menyapu kotoran ke sudut dengan irama yang pelan tapi mantap.

ed018766ec2d.en: Vol 2 Chapter II subchapter 2: Harry waves from a wagon beside an old man with a pipe, three girls standing in the street behind.
ed018766ec2d.t: Jilid 2 Bab II subbab 2: Harry melambai dari kereta di samping pria tua berpipa, tiga gadis berdiri di jalan di belakangnya.

ed349a75831e.en: Harry was seated silently in the kitchen, making ASMR sounds as his teeth ripped apart the crunchy multigrain bread of a meaty sandwich.
ed349a75831e.t: Harry duduk diam di dapur, mengeluarkan bunyi-bunyi ASMR saat giginya mengoyak roti multigrain yang renyah dari sebuah sandwich daging.

ede758a51a0b.en: With a motherly hug, Eiri spoke in his ear. “Don’t worry too much! Just live day by day, and send me as many winga mails as you want! I will be sure to reply to them!”
ede758a51a0b.t: Dengan pelukan keibuan, Eiri berbicara di telinganya. “Jangan terlalu khawatir! Jalani saja hari demi hari, dan kirimi aku winga mail sebanyak yang kamu mau! Aku pasti akan membalasnya!”

ee9a563609e1.en: “Harry! Ready to go?” Eiri slowly poked through the swinging door, holding a furry, leathery bag with a shoulder strap. The bag had red strands of hair on the side, accenting its brownish fur.
ee9a563609e1.t: “Harry! Siap berangkat?” Eiri perlahan menyembul dari pintu ayun, memegang sebuah tas kulit berbulu dengan tali bahu. Tas itu punya helai-helai rambut merah di sisinya, mempertegas bulu kecokelatannya.

f0d6bcdea74c.en: Trying to juggle his memories again, Harry remembered another factoid. “Neferteri for monarchy!”
f0d6bcdea74c.t: Mencoba mengutak-atik ingatannya lagi, Harry teringat satu fakta kecil lagi. “Neferteri untuk monarki!”

f48b35814183.en: He has a contract to fill too? The bumps of the carriage grew more intense, making him feel pinching in his bladder. “I’m sorry, Sinoi, but I need to pee!”
f48b35814183.t: Dia juga punya kontrak yang harus dipenuhi? Guncangan kereta semakin hebat, membuatnya merasakan kandung kemihnya tercubit. “Maaf, Sinoi, tapi aku harus kencing!”

f529739efc27.en: “Eiri for economical?” Harry looked at Arukia like he were asking for a plea deal. His eyes looked only, and only, at her brightly cyan eyes—even though there was still the same gravity pull towards the fun in between her breast valleys.
f529739efc27.t: “Eiri untuk ekonomi?” Harry memandang Arukia seolah sedang memohon keringanan hukuman. Matanya hanya, dan hanya, memandang mata sian cerahnya—walaupun masih ada tarikan gravitasi yang sama ke arah kesenangan di antara lembah payudaranya.

f5aee3980a6d.en: Noticing Sora’s armadillo mode, Eiri poked her sides. “C’mon, Sora! I didn’t even say banging this time! Hmmm, or is the shy mode because you actually don’t want to say bye to your future husband?”
f5aee3980a6d.t: Melihat mode trenggiling Sora, Eiri menyodok sisi tubuhnya. “Ayolah, Sora! Kali ini aku bahkan tidak bilang ngewe! Hmmm, atau mode malu ini karena kamu sebenarnya tidak mau berpamitan dengan calon suamimu?”

f7f47cd6e44b.en: Harry could not get himself to open his eyes; he remained in a fetal position while sobbing profusely. He pictured himself with his parents and the dog as they ate tacos and watched TV. He still couldn’t remember anything about them, but the feeling of being home was still there. I wanna go home.
f7f47cd6e44b.t: Harry tidak bisa memaksa dirinya membuka mata; ia tetap dalam posisi janin sambil terisak-isak hebat. Ia membayangkan dirinya bersama orang tuanya dan anjingnya saat mereka makan taco dan menonton TV. Ia masih tidak bisa mengingat apa pun tentang mereka, tetapi perasaan berada di rumah masih ada. Aku mau pulang.

f9752e3e459b.en: An effervescent, butterfly feeling arose within Harry. He left the empty plate back as he stood up and began walking towards her, but his curiosity took the best out of him, taking one last look at Itanema before leaving the kitchen.
f9752e3e459b.t: Perasaan meletup-letup seperti kupu-kupu di perut muncul dalam diri Harry. Ia meninggalkan piring kosong itu sambil berdiri dan mulai berjalan ke arahnya, tetapi rasa penasarannya mengalahkannya, membuatnya memandang Itanema sekali terakhir sebelum meninggalkan dapur.

fa72c1462565.en: Feeling even more so like a déjà vu, Harry could almost see the hundreds of people gathered outside, all curiously looking at him as his previous undersized clothing was so stretched that it made his belly appear twice as big. However, this time, only tens of people were around, and they were all busy going about their business. Some carriages passed by, others walked, and some even curiously glanced at the door as they kept on going. A few gave a nod or a wave as they passed by, but that’s it. As they walked outside, Harry noticed a couple kissing passionately in front of the Sanbi fountain. Their kissing was so intense, it looked like their faces had been glued.
fa72c1462565.t: Merasa semakin seperti déjà vu, Harry hampir bisa melihat ratusan orang berkumpul di luar, semuanya memandangnya dengan penasaran karena pakaiannya yang dulu kekecilan begitu teregang sampai membuat perutnya tampak dua kali lebih besar. Namun, kali ini, hanya ada puluhan orang di sekitar, dan mereka semua sibuk dengan urusan masing-masing. Beberapa kereta lewat, yang lain berjalan kaki, dan beberapa bahkan melirik penasaran ke arah pintu sambil terus berjalan. Beberapa mengangguk atau melambai saat lewat, tetapi hanya itu. Saat mereka berjalan keluar, Harry melihat sepasang kekasih berciuman penuh gairah di depan air mancur Sanbi. Ciuman mereka begitu intens, tampak seolah wajah mereka sudah dilem.

fdb138c20415.en: Harry kept on releasing a torrential stream of piss as he saw the carriage gather speed. The situation seemed so unreal that Harry initially thought it was all a product of his imagination—or perhaps just a dream and that he was about to wake up on a Monday morning, staring at his phone, yearning to call in sick or tell his boss to get fucked rather than deal with that shit. Wait! What the fuck am I thinking? Harry snapped out of it as the carriage kept going. “MY BAG!” He shouted as he was still peeing.
fdb138c20415.t: Harry terus mengeluarkan aliran air kencing yang deras saat ia melihat kereta menambah kecepatan. Situasinya tampak begitu tidak nyata sampai Harry awalnya mengira semuanya hanya produk imajinasinya—atau mungkin hanya mimpi dan ia akan terbangun di Senin pagi, menatap ponselnya, berharap bisa izin sakit atau menyuruh bosnya pergi ke neraka ketimbang menghadapi urusan sialan itu. Tunggu! Apa yang kupikirkan, bangsat? Harry tersadar saat kereta terus melaju. “TASKU!” teriaknya sambil masih kencing.

fe741dbb138c.en: With a click of her tongue, Arukia came back to Harry and handed over a half-drank glass with a bonus faint red lip mark. “Here’s your consolation prize.”
fe741dbb138c.t: Dengan decakan lidahnya, Arukia kembali ke Harry dan menyerahkan gelas yang tinggal setengah dengan bonus bekas bibir merah yang samar. “Ini hadiah hiburanmu.”

ff794a2d8768.en: Making his first significant body motion, Sinoi waved his hand left as the other pulled on the reins, bringing the carriage to a slow stop in the middle of another T-shaped intersection. Going forward would keep encircling the castle walls, while turning left would go on another straight road just as large as the one they were in. This road had the identical sturdy fost stone lamp posts equally spaced from each other, each surrounded by a small garden of bluish flowers that vibrantly shined in the sunlight. Sinoi waved for a few more carriages to pass by, then he shook his reins, creaking the carriage as it turned left towards this new road.
ff794a2d8768.t: Melakukan gerakan tubuh berarti pertamanya, Sinoi melambaikan tangannya ke kiri sementara tangan yang lain menarik tali kekang, membuat kereta perlahan berhenti di tengah persimpangan berbentuk T lainnya. Lurus ke depan akan terus mengitari tembok kastil, sementara belok kiri akan menuju jalan lurus lain yang sama besarnya dengan jalan yang mereka lalui. Jalan ini punya tiang-tiang lampu fost stone kokoh yang identik dengan jarak yang sama satu sama lain, masing-masing dikelilingi taman kecil berisi bunga-bunga kebiruan yang bersinar cerah di bawah sinar matahari. Sinoi melambai agar beberapa kereta lagi lewat, lalu ia mengguncang tali kekangnya, membuat kereta berderit saat berbelok kiri menuju jalan baru ini.

ffa48aefc86b.en: Sinoi returned to being immobile while the egua carried on, trotting through this darkening road. A few clusters of white gloom shone on the darkening road ahead, with a stronger white gloom in the sky far ahead—perhaps a village was waiting for them there. As they trotted towards it, the noises of the forest were overshadowed by echoes of live music—whoever was playing the trombone was going above and beyond.
ffa48aefc86b.t: Sinoi kembali tak bergerak sementara egua terus melaju, berderap di jalan yang semakin gelap ini. Beberapa gugusan cahaya putih redup bersinar di jalan yang semakin gelap di depan, dengan cahaya putih yang lebih kuat di langit jauh di depan—mungkin sebuah desa sedang menunggu mereka di sana. Saat mereka berderap menuju ke sana, suara-suara hutan tertutupi gema musik langsung—siapa pun yang memainkan trombon itu bermain luar biasa.
